jobs.title: Full Stack Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Octavian Robotics is solving the #1 complication in the $3T surgical industry. We are building robots for the sterilization of surgical tools. Only now with generalized robotics models have we been able to tackle this problem and save lives.

This company is a spin-out from Sorting Robotics and we are inheriting a decade of robotics infrastructure and know-how. **The role is for the first robotics software engineer at the company.** You'll be working directly with the founders and learning from the previous team on how to build a robotics company. You'll need to be scrappy, a jack of all trades and a master of one, be able to communicate your ideas quickly and effectively, adapt to changing dynamics, have experience with robotics, and be able to push through the journey of building a new company.

This role is not for the faint of heart. You should expect to work 60+ hours a week, expect for there to be more problems than solutions, expect for you to have very little hand-holding, invent technology that didn't exist 6 months ago, expect to feel the pressure of performance when everyone in the room is depending on you and there are millions of dollars on the line. All this will be true, but you will also be in a room of people that respect you; where everyone is rowing together to achieve the noble goal of saving lives with our robotic systems.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and implement software to control machines developed by Octavian Robotics.
* Build and implement the initial infrastructure of the company.
* Work closely with mechanical and electrical engineers and guide design decisions based on what software can effectively accomplish.
* Work closely with customer success and sales staff to translate customer and company needs into software solutions.
* Train entry/mid-level software developers in the development lifecycle of the product lines you're working on.
* Work with engineers and customer success staff to remote and debug logs in the machine and understand customer problems.
* This is an on-site position. You're expected to work on-site with the other team members five days a week. We are based in Los Angeles.

Sometimes, nothing will work, and you'll need to conduct experiments until the problem's root cause (hardware or software-related) is fully understood.

Before writing any code, you must deeply understand complex topics and communicate proposed solutions to a highly technical team. Ideally, you write the minimum number of lines that solve the problem ("spin lock? Why not? It solves this problem" - "I'll just use a JSON file for now as a database so anyone can easily modify it").

Your work will be focused more on clear communication and business impact than on lines of code you can write or cool tech you can use.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Python
* Familiarity with Git
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, AWS services
* Familiarity with web standards, RESTful APIs, OAuth
* Experience training VLA or inference models for motor control

You will work on different parts of the stack at various times. We expect you to understand where everything goes and why, and we expect you to add to the stack to make the development process more robust.

 **Requirements**  

* Must be AI-Native in all workflows
* Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
* Experience with Linux (systemd, journalctl, network manager, permissions).
* Hands-on experience in robotics or computer vision
* Experience working with Hardware.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Authorized to work in the US without visa sponsorship.

  
**Benefits**  

* $170,000 - $190,000 per year full-time salary.
* 0.5% - 1% equity.
* Health, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending account, paid time off, parental leave.
* Schedule: 12-hour shift, Monday - Saturday. This job is not for the weak of heart.
* In person, Van Nuys or Los Angeles, CA. Relocation package available.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer I
jobs.description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

**Full Stack Software Engineer I**

Parallel Systems is seeking a Software Engineer I to join our Interfaces team. The Interfaces team builds the software people use to operate, monitor, and manage our vehicles and fleet, including our main operator application and the product surfaces that will grow into enterprise customer software. This is a junior role with real ownership. You do not need years of production experience, but you do need high agency, clear communication, and the hunger to learn fast. We care more about how you work than how many years you have been paid to work.

**Responsibilities:**

* Build and improve the operator and customer product platform in TypeScript, React, and Rust.
* Ship features in our Electron operator application.
* Work with product and vehicle/systems engineers to turn operational needs into clear, reliable interfaces.
* Own features end-to-end: understand the user, implement, test, document, and follow through after merge.
* Grow into full-stack product work as we expand enterprise software, including data models, APIs, and the performance and reliability of software that talks to the real world.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* **After 30 Days:** You've set up your environment, learned how operators use our application, and shipped your first changes to the software platform. You're asking good questions early and building relationships with product and vehicle/systems engineers.
* **After 60 Days:** You've owned a feature end-to-end, from understanding the operator's need through implementation, testing, documentation, and follow-through after merge. You're reading and improving code across the Interfaces codebase.
* **After 90 Days:** You're a reliable contributor to the operator application, independently identifying and fixing problems without waiting to be assigned. You've started contributing beyond the UI, such as data models, APIs, or performance and reliability improvements for our enterprise software.

**Basic Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamp plus portfolio, research, or shipped projects are fine).
* Comfortable writing software in TypeScript or Rust and component-based UI (React or similar). You can read other people's code and leave it better than you found it.
* A track record of picking up a new tool, language, or domain and becoming useful with it, whether through a class project, internship, research, open source, or something you built because you wanted it to exist.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Project or professional experience with Rust, React, TypeScript, or Python.
* Exposure to desktop wrappers (Electron, Tauri), backend development, or databases.
* Coursework or projects touching networks, operating systems, or distributed systems.
* Experience pairing with AI coding tools and being honest about what they got wrong.

*Parallel Systems is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any discriminatory factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. We work to build an inclusive environment in which all people can come to do their best work.*

*Parallel Systems is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Parallel Systems will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact your recruiter.*

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Auction.com, we’re transforming real estate. As the nation’s leading online platform for buying and selling residential bank-owned and foreclosure properties, we connect buyers, sellers, and investors with innovative technology. With over $70 billion in assets, our success is driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact. We go beyond the bid—empowering our people to thrive and shape the future of the industry
  
  
About the role
  
We run one of the largest digital marketplaces in residential real estate, where buyers, sellers, servicers, and agents transact on real property with real money at stake. Every listing that moves through our platform touches valuation, bidding, contracts, payments, and a long list of external systems, and the platform keeps evolving to meet the needs of the market.
  
We're hiring Senior Full Stack Software Engineers to help build and evolve that platform. You'll work in React and TypeScript on the front end, with Node, Kotlin, and GraphQL services behind it, running on AWS and Kubernetes.
  
At the senior level, you'll own complex features and technical solutions end to end—from design and architecture through build, test, deployment, and production support. You'll also help raise the engineering bar through thoughtful design decisions, code reviews, mentoring, and technical leadership.
  
What the work looks like
  
You'll work in a lean technology organization (~50 engineers), which means there isn't a lot of distance between you and the work that matters.
  
What you build ships.
  
You'll design and deliver customer-facing features and the services that power them, balancing speed with scalability, maintainability, and long-term technical health.
  
You'll help shape technical approaches before development begins—identifying tradeoffs, challenging assumptions, and helping the team make sound architecture and design decisions.
  
You'll test what you build, with automated coverage across unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing wired into CI. We don't hand code to someone else to verify.
  
You'll debug complex production issues across distributed systems and help identify root causes, not just short-term fixes.
  
You'll be an active voice in design discussions and code reviews. Senior engineers here are expected to bring perspective, challenge approaches when needed, and help other engineers get better.
  
You'll work directly with product, UX, data, and other engineers. Many of the most important technical and product decisions happen in those conversations.
  
You'll also have room to build AI-enabled features. We're actively incorporating LLMs into customer and internal workflows, and engineers here are helping shape what that looks like.
  
Who does well here
  
You get curious when something doesn't add up. A weird log line, a metric that moved unexpectedly, or a function nobody can explain—you go find out why instead of routing around it.
  
You take ownership. Blockers are problems to solve, and you're comfortable navigating ambiguity, evaluating options, and moving work forward.
  
You have strong technical judgment. You know when a simple solution is enough and when scalability, performance, security, or architecture requires deeper thinking.
  
You make the engineers around you better. You share context, provide thoughtful code reviews, mentor others, and help establish good engineering practices without needing a formal leadership title.
  
You're still learning. Technology changes quickly, and you're genuinely interested in learning new tools and approaches—including AI—and applying them where they make sense.
  
You care whether it worked. Not whether the ticket closed, but whether the customer's problem was actually solved.
  
What you bring
  

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production applications
* Strong experience with React and TypeScript, or comparable modern front-end technologies
* Experience building backend services with Node.js, Kotlin/Java, or similar technologies
* Experience designing and working with REST and/or GraphQL APIs
* Hands-on experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform
* Practical experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* Strong automated testing practices across unit, integration, API, and/or end-to-end testing
* Experience with CI/CD and modern software delivery practices
* Experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores
* Experience designing or contributing to scalable, distributed production systems
* Strong judgment around performance, scalability, reliability, and security
* Ability to independently own complex technical work from design through production
* Experience mentoring engineers, contributing to code/design reviews, and helping improve engineering practices

If you have most of this and a track record of picking up the rest quickly, apply anyway. We'd rather hire someone who continues to learn than someone who simply checked every box five years ago.
  
AI and emerging technology
  
You don't need to be an AI or ML engineer. We're looking for senior software engineers who are genuinely curious about this space and want to apply it to real customer and business problems.
  
**Any of the following is a plus:** LLM and generative AI application development, AI API integrations, AWS Bedrock or comparable platforms, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), conversational interfaces, or agent and workflow automation. Personal projects count.
  
Nice to have
  

* Background in fintech, proptech, real estate, mortgage, lending, payments, e-commerce, or marketplaces
* Experience with high-volume transactional systems
* Microservices, distributed systems, or event-driven architecture
* Experience modernizing legacy applications or services
* Experience on a team where engineers owned both delivery and quality

jobs.description:
Join the Leader in Brain and Mental Health

At Amen Clinics Inc./Mindworks Innovations Inc., our vision is bold: to be known as the best brain and mental health company in the world. Every member of our team plays a vital role in making that vision a reality—delivering exceptional care, advancing innovation, and changing lives every day.

About Mindworks Innovations, Inc. & Amen Clinics, Inc.

At Amen Clinics, Inc./Mindworks Innovations Inc., we’re proud to be an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) company. That means every employee is also an owner, sharing in the success and growth of the organization. As part of our team, you won’t just be contributing to our mission — you’ll be building long-term value for yourself and your future. Ownership isn’t just a benefit here; it’s a mindset we bring to everything we do.

Amen Clinics are outpatient health care clinics that have been providing mental wellness strategies to patients of all ages since 1989. We offer patient-first experiences and customized solutions to an array of behavioral and psychiatric conditions. Amen Clinics employs an array of healthcare professionals across our nationwide locations, including psychiatrists, integrative physicians, nutritionists, therapists, and wellness coaches. These practitioners have diverse educational backgrounds and specialties and are skilled at treating patients in the least harmful, most effective means possible. We use all the tools available to us to help make brain health happen. We believe that a better brain always leads to a better life and that achieving our mission will help to prevent and alleviate suffering, not only for individuals but also for generations of individuals.

Job Description and Purpose:

The Full Stack Developer will build and enhance web and mobile applications across a range of projects. You will develop user-facing features, backend services, and integrations using Flutter, Dart, and appropriate web and backend technologies. You will also help implement AI-powered features using existing models and services.

You will work closely with product managers, UI/UX designers, QA engineers, and other developers to deliver reliable, user-friendly applications. This role focuses on implementing defined features within an established architecture, with guidance from a technical lead on complex design decisions and AI implementation.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

* Develop and maintain mobile applications for iOS and Android using Flutter and Dart, and contribute to web applications using the project’s established technologies.
* Build and maintain backend services, databases, and REST APIs that support application workflows, user accounts, content, and integrations with business systems.
* Implement assigned features within an established architecture and recommend practical improvements to usability, maintainability, and performance.
* Integrate third-party APIs and SDKs, including AI services for defined use cases such as summarization, conversational interfaces, or image analysis.
* Implement provided prompts, output validation, error handling, and fallback behavior for AI features, with technical guidance where needed.
* Run established AI evaluation tests, document unexpected outputs, and help resolve issues using approved criteria and safeguards.
* Follow secure coding practices and organizational requirements for authentication, access controls, sensitive data, and approved AI services.
* Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers, and QA engineers to clarify requirements, review acceptance criteria, and deliver responsive, accessible experiences.
* Participate in code reviews, incorporate feedback, document code and integrations, and share knowledge with teammates.
* Collaborate with internal and external developers on assigned features and integrations.
* Write and maintain automated tests, support existing CI/CD pipelines, and participate in release testing and bug fixes.
* Troubleshoot production issues and performance bottlenecks; use application analytics and user feedback to improve reliability and usability.
* Participate in Scrum or Kanban planning, estimate assigned work, and communicate progress, risks, and blockers to the project manager or technical lead.

Qualifications & Requirements

* 3+ years of professional software development experience, including user-facing applications and backend services.
* At least 1 year of hands-on Flutter development experience, with practical proficiency in Dart, state management, asynchronous programming, and API integration.
* Experience building a substantial Flutter application; ability to explain implementation decisions, troubleshoot issues, and incorporate code-review feedback.

Rim Universe is building an AI-native platform for animated and serialized video content creation. Our platform helps creators transform ideas and scripts into structured production workflows, including story development, character creation, episode and shot planning, AI image/video generation, and editing.

We are currently expanding our engineering team and looking for a **Backend Engineer** to help build the core backend infrastructure powering our platform. If you're passionate about AI video creation, we'd love to have you join our team and help turn more great stories into amazing videos!

About the Role

As a Backend Engineer at Rim Universe, you will be responsible for building and maintaining backend systems supporting **AI model integrations, generation workflows, media asset management, and user/project data**.

You will work closely with our AI and product teams to build reliable, scalable backend services that support AI-powered content generation in a production environment.

Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services using **Python and FastAPI**
* Build and maintain **REST APIs** for our platform
* Integrate third-party APIs, including **LLM, image generation, and video generation models**
* Design and optimize **PostgreSQL** databases and queries
* Build asynchronous AI generation workflows, including task queues, status tracking, retries, failure handling, and webhooks
* Develop backend systems for users, projects, generated content, and media assets
* Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot services in **Docker/Linux** environments
* Improve system reliability, scalability, maintainability, and performance
* Collaborate with AI, frontend, and product team members to deliver production-ready features

Requirements

* **2+ years** of backend development experience, with at least one project taken through development, launch and ongoing maintenance.
* Strong **Python** skills and hands-on production experience with **FastAPI** or **Django**. Able to quickly read and maintain an existing codebase.
* Experience with **PostgreSQL**, database design, and SQL optimization.
* Understands how background job systems work: job state machines, **leases and heartbeats**, timeouts, **retries**, **idempotency** and **failure recovery**. Familiar with reliable messaging patterns such as the **transactional outbox**. Has used **Redis** (Streams, locks or queues).
* Experience integrating **third-party HTTP APIs**, including authentication, **async callbacks**, **status polling**, **rate limiting** and **error classification**. Understands why a **pay-per-call API** must not be blindly retried when the outcome of a call is unknown.
* Experience with **LLM API** integration, **prompt template** management or **agent** development.
* Familiar with object storage such as **S3** or **MinIO**: **presigned URLs**, uploads and downloads, and **access control**. Able to guarantee **multi-tenant data isolation**.
* Comfortable with **Linux**, **Docker / Docker Compose** and **Git**. Able to investigate logs, manage secrets, run backup and restore, and write tests for critical flows.

Nice to Have

* Hands-on work on **AI video, image or speech generation**, or audio/video processing; familiarity with **FFmpeg**.
* Experience with the **ComfyUI API** or building **multi-step generation workflows** (e.g. speech synthesis → video generation → lip sync).
* Experience building **Stripe** payments, subscriptions, credit ledgers or usage-based billing.
* Experience optimizing generation job performance, analyzing model costs or planning service capacity.
* Working knowledge of **Node.js / TypeScript** (our frontend BFF uses Next.js).

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Gallatin**
==================

At Gallatin, we are rebuilding logistics infrastructure for the national security missions of the United States and allied partners. We build AI systems that determine how logistics decisions are made — not just how they're executed. From factory to foxhole, we operate at the layer where data becomes decisions, and decisions make the advantage.

**About the Role**
==================

We’re looking for a **Backend Software Enginee**r to design, build, and scale the core systems that power our AI-driven logistics platform. This is a foundational role: you’ll own reliable, high-performance backend services, APIs, and data pipelines that our products depend on.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Backend Development & System Design**

  + Create scalable, resilient backend services and APIs for our logistics solutions.
  + Own system architecture, balancing performance, scalability, and security.
  + Partner with front-end, AI/ML, and product teams to integrate services smoothly.
  + Drive high availability and reliability through proactive monitoring, logging, and alerting.
  + Build and maintain thorough testing strategies (unit, integration, and performance) to keep the platform stable.
* **Data Processing & Integration**

  + Develop pipelines that ingest data from real-time, batch, structured, and unstructured sources.
  + Ensure data is consistent, reliable, and available through thoughtful schema design and database optimization.
* **Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

  + Contribute to code reviews, coding standards, best practices, and documentation.
  + Track backend development trends and introduce improvements to our stack where they make sense.
  + Support the onboarding and mentoring of new teammates as the team grows.

**What We’re Looking For**
==========================

* **Strong Technical Background**

  + Proficiency in one or more backend languages: Python, Node.js, Typescript or Java
  + Solid understanding of API design and implementation (REST, GraphQL).
  + Hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, or Redis.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure Experience**

  + Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  + Experience deploying and running containerized applications with Docker and Kubernetes.
  + Understanding of infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* **Software Best Practices**

  + Experience with software testing methodologies (unit, integration, end-to-end testing).
  + A commitment to writing clean, maintainable, well-documented code.
* **Problem-solving & Communication**

  + Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to debug complex systems.
  + Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and explain technical concepts clearly.
* **Growth Mindset**

  + Passion for continuous learning and staying current with the latest advancements in backend engineering, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure, as well as a commitment to mentoring and teaching others.

**Bonus Points**
================

* Experience with building and integrating on Palantir Foundry and its various offerings
* Knowledge of defense or logistics industries and legacy system modernization.
* Contributions to open-source software or active engagement with the developer community.

**Mission and Identity**
========================

We are building the system that enables faster, smarter logistics decisions in contested environments, and we're doing it with a team of seasoned entrepreneurs, operators, and technologists who have built and scaled solutions in this space before. We hold ourselves to an extremely high standard. We value clear thinking, direct communication, and the kind of ownership that doesn't stop until something actually works.

Our mission is to create decision advantage when the stakes are the highest. If we succeed, the system doesn't just run; it gets smarter. We're not building AI for its own sake. We're building it because faster, smarter decisions in the most demanding environments on earth can't wait. If you want to work somewhere the stakes are real and the mission is urgent — you'll fit in here.

**Why Gallatin?**
=================

The logistics infrastructure that supports America's warfighters and humanitarian disaster responders is overdue for transformation, and we are building it. From defense operations to disaster response, we're solving the hardest problems that keep missions moving when it matters most. Join a team where the mission is the point.  
  
**Compensation:** Gallatin offers competitive compensation commensurate with experience. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a generous equity grant, full healthcare coverage, 401k, unlimited PTO, and the perks of working in a high-caliber, mission-driven environment.

*Gallatin is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

*This position may require the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. The successful candidate must be able to work in a classified environment when necessary.*

*We comply with the United States Department of Labor's**Pay Transparency provision**.*

Note: Due to the nature of certain government contracts held by this organization, U.S. citizenship is a requirement for all positions at Gallatin. Proof of citizenship will be required prior to employment if selected.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**About The Team**
------------------

The Sentry Tower Software team develops robotic systems that provide force protection capabilities, monitoring the perimeter of secure areas, land or sea, for approaching people, vehicles, and vessels. We live in a world where security officers are increasingly overwhelmed by sensor data feeds. Our products leverage advanced sensor fusion and autonomy to seamlessly render activity in the environment to Lattice's common operating picture.

**About the Job**
-----------------

Sentry Towers are robotic systems: motors, cameras, radars, radios, and sensor boards, running on NVIDIA Jetson compute in the field. Verifying that a system like this works means accounting for physical actuation, real sensor data, and hardware that fails in ways no unit test anticipates. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own our simulation and hardware test infrastructure and make automated, whole-system testing the default for everything we ship. A regression that escapes here does not surface on a developer's laptop. It surfaces on a tower at a site someone has to fly to, guarding a perimeter that does not pause while we debug.

You will work across both halves of the problem. Our software-in-the-loop environments are declaratively defined multi-node virtual towers, complete with a simulated ground control station, synthetic sensor feeds, and a game-engine-driven world, which lets us run whole-system scenarios in CI with no hardware attached. Our hardware-in-the-loop side drives real Jetson-based towers through a board test server: provisioning them over the network, flashing firmware, installing full system images, and reporting results back through our CI pipeline on a nightly and weekend cadence.

Both foundations are in place and working, so you are inheriting infrastructure rather than starting from nothing. What does not exist yet is most of what sits on top: the functional test suites, the scenario library, and the diagnostic tooling that turn a booting tower into a verified one are yours to design. Firmware integration, compute platform bring-up, and both our Air Defense and Counter-Intrusion business lines depend on this capability, and what you build becomes the standard they test against.

Test infrastructure is a job where the wins are invisible and the failures are loud. You will spend real time on work nobody asks for by name: chasing intermittent failures to root cause instead of retrying them, waiting on hardware that is scarce and shared, and rebuilding coverage when a compute generation changes underneath you. The measure of the role is bugs that never reach a tower, which means much of your best work leaves no trace anyone thanks you for.

Our Product: https://www.anduril.com/sentry

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Own and grow our SITL environments: add product variants and scenarios, keep the simulated sensor and video pipelines faithful enough to be trustworthy, and keep whole-system test runtimes short enough to fit inside a normal development cycle.
* Build out functional coverage on the HITL bench across the behavior that matters: motion control and trajectory execution, camera and sensor bring-up, firmware update paths, network failover, and clean recovery from power loss and unexpected reboots.
* Own the CI integration end to end: scheduling, dependency chaining between test stages, artifact and log capture, result reporting, and the flake triage that keeps a hardware pipeline trusted instead of ignored.
* Grow the test platform continuously as the product line does. New compute generations, new payloads, and new product variants each need coverage, and keeping the framework ahead of the roadmap is the enduring core of this role.
* Make failures diagnosable without touching the rig. Invest in log capture, serial console capture, and test artifacts so an engineer can root-cause from the CI output alone.
* Partner with hardware and manufacturing engineers to stand up the physical HITL benches, specifying the fixtures, switching, power control, and instrumentation needed to exercise towers unattended. This is a substantial upfront build with periodic expansion as new hardware arrives.
* Partner with firmware, platform, and business line teams so they can add their own tests against your framework, and support them as their first users.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------

* 4+ years of professional software engineering, with meaningful time spent building test infrastructure, CI systems, or simulation for systems that involve real hardware.
* Proficiency in Python for test authoring and automation, plus working ability in Rust or C++ to read and debug the services under test.
* Demonstrated experience automating tests against physical hardware: device provisioning, remote power and reset control, serial consoles, network booting, or instrumented benches.
* Strong CI/CD engineering skills, including pipelines with expensive stages, hardware resource contention, and scheduled rather than per-commit execution.

jobs.description:

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

**Meet the Moment with Alteryx**

At Alteryx, we're building technology that helps organizations connect to, manage, and work with their data securely and efficiently. As data, automation, and AI continue to evolve, our cloud platform plays an important role in helping customers solve complex problems and make better decisions.

We're looking for engineers who enjoy meaningful technical challenges, value collaboration, and want to build technology that makes a real difference.

  

**Position Overview**

We're looking for a **Software Engineer** to join our Data Plane Transport team within Cloud Platform Engineering. Our team builds and operates foundational services that enable secure, reliable communication between Alteryx Cloud, data planes, and customer environments. orchestration across distributed cloud environments.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, contribute to technical decisions, and take ownership of features and improvements from development through production.

orchestration, routing, and proxy/relay-based communication.

deployment, and production support.

Contribute to frontend applications and platform management experiences using TypeScript and React when needed.

Investigate and troubleshoot issues across application code, cloud infrastructure, and networking components.

Improve automated testing, monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational tooling. Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and code reviews while collaborating with Product, Infrastructure, Security, and other engineering teams.

Participate in an on-call rotation after onboarding, helping maintain production reliability and address recurring issues.

  

**Required Qualification** s

Strong software engineering fundamentals, including debugging, automated testing, and writing clean, maintainable code.

development practices.

Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to independently deliver

jobs.title: Layout Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a highly skilled R&D Engineer with extensive hands-on experience in RFIC, MMIC, RF module, or analog/mixed-signal layout, combined with an interest in advancing layout automation and design productivity.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in developing and optimizing complex high-frequency IC layouts, with practical understanding of RF layout considerations such as device placement, matching, routing, shielding, isolation, passive structures, parasitic effects, and electromagnetic interactions.

This role is primarily focused on RFIC/MMIC layout and physical design, while also providing opportunities to contribute to layout automation through Python, parameterized layout generation, and collaboration with software and automation engineers.

Responsibilities:

* Develop physical layouts for RF, microwave, and analog integrated circuits.
* Work closely with circuit designers to translate schematics into high-quality, manufacturable layouts.
* Apply RF/analog layout techniques including device matching, symmetry, shielding, grounding, isolation, and parasitic optimization.
* Layout active devices and passive structures such as transistors, resistors, capacitors, inductors, transmission lines, and matching networks.
* Optimize layouts for electrical performance, area, manufacturability, and reliability.
* Perform and debug DRC, LVS, and other physical verification checks.
* Support layout iterations based on simulation, extraction, and design feedback.
* Use Python scripting to improve productivity and automate repetitive layout and design-flow tasks.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing layout workflows through automation.
* Collaborate with software and automation engineers to translate practical layout requirements into automated solutions.

Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on experience in RFIC, microwave, analog, or mixed-signal IC layout.
* Solid understanding of RF and analog layout techniques and physical design considerations.
* Experience with industry-standard IC layout and physical verification tools.
* Experience with DRC, LVS, and parasitic-aware layout.
* Ability to work closely with RF/analog circuit designers.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with MMIC/RFIC design and layout.
* Experience with technologies such as GaAs, GaN, SiGe, RF CMOS, or other RF semiconductor processes.
* Familiarity with Python-based scripting or layout workflow automation.
* Experience developing or working with reusable/parameterized layout structures.
* Interest in improving engineering productivity through automation.

As a **Software Engineer, Product** at Prelim, you will own critical parts of the platform that powers digital onboarding for financial institutions across the world. You'll work directly with our customers, product team, and engineering leadership to build systems that handle everything from online deposit account opening to in-branch experiences, account maintenance, treasury services onboarding, credit card applications, and every other type of financial institution onboarding imaginable.

**This isn't just another full-stack role, it's the chance to build the infrastructure that millions depend on.**  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Architect and build features across our entire stack handling massive scale and complexity.
* Build, enhance and fix the systems that seamlessly integrate with legacy bank infrastructure, core banking systems, and third-party compliance providers.
* Solve complex technical challenges around multi-tenant architecture, real-time data processing, and bank-grade reliability requirements.
* Work directly with major banks to understand their unique onboarding requirements and translate complex business logic into elegant technical solutions.
* Own the performance, scalability, and reliability of systems processing millions of applications across hundreds of different banking products.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience with modern web technologies (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL preferred). Whether you're a new graduate with impressive projects or an experienced engineer, we want to hear from you.
* Strong system design skills and experience with scalable architectures, you'll be building systems that immediately help millions.
* You thrive on solving complex technical problems with business context. You can break down complicated banking requirements and build elegant solutions.
* You care about business impact and can balance technical excellence with shipping features that move the business forward.
* You think deeply about user experience, whether you're building for every day people opening accounts or bank employees processing applications.
* You're excited about working directly with customers, understanding their complex needs, and iterating quickly based on feedback.
* You want to own significant parts of the product and help shape technical decisions as we scale.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering.
* Legally authorized to work in the United States and located within the continental United States

**About Prelim**

Prelim is a San Francisco and New York City-based startup that operates with fully remote positions across the US, helping banks onboard their customers. Our platform is designed to streamline the account opening process for both consumers and businesses, accelerating speed-to-market and enhancing the customer experience for financial institutions. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the banking industry, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Prelim. We are seeking individuals who are driven, ambitious, and eager to make a real impact in a traditional industry ready for technological innovation.

We offer equity, a sponsored 401K, parental leave, and fully paid health, vision, and dental insurance. Additional benefits include unlimited PTO, a remote work stipend, a life-style stipend, and twice-yearly company retreats.

Prelim values diversity and inclusion; people of all backgrounds are welcome to join our mission to transform banking.

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer (Rust)
jobs.description:
Umbra is an American space technology company delivering advanced systems, from sensors to spacecraft, that empower customers worldwide with unmatched access to critical information from space. Our mission is simple and ambitious: redefine space—for people, systems, and missions in every domain. Umbra’s ecosystem operates through three business units: Remote Sensing (the data), Space Systems (the components), and Mission Solutions (the platforms).Together, our teams develop capabilities that deliver persistent access, resilient performance, and mission-ready solutions, advancing U.S. space leadership while keeping the world safe and informed.

**About the Team**

**Space Systems – The Components**

Space Systems is where Umbra turns hardware and software designs into on-orbit realities; developing, implementing and iterating mission-ready core technology, while simultaneously advancing the next generation of our own satellite constellation. Space Systems is vertically integrated across the satellite architecture, thus the team designs, builds, and tests an array of critical components and subsystems, including power systems, communications, control systems, deployment hardware, avionics, and payloads, as well as the flight software, firmware and digital design solutions to support the entire hardware stack. Our focus is on first principles engineering, and our mandate is simple: it has to work when it counts. Every bolt, board, and binary is proven on our own SAR constellation, ensuring flight-proven reliability where failure is not an option.

If you want to work on cutting edge space technology while maintaining the highest standard for innovation and mission ready performance, you belong here at Umbra.

**About the Job**

We are seeking a **Flight Software Engineer** who has experience in Rust programming language to take an active role in the development and delivery of embedded flight software specifically tailored for Umbra missions. In this pivotal role, you will be tasked with a range of critical responsibilities, including but not limited to the formulation and specification of software requirements, the comprehensive design of robust software architecture, and the actual writing and implementation of code. You will take lead responsibility for the essential processes of system integration and testing, ensuring that all components function seamlessly together.

In addition to your core development responsibilities, you will also be expected to provide expert guidance and mentorship in various aspects of software design, code development, and peer code reviews. Your role will include oversight of thorough documentation practices and the meticulous integration of the flight software with flight hardware, which encompasses conducting unit testing to ensure reliability and performance. Your contributions will be vital to the success of our missions, driving innovation and excellence in software engineering within our team.

**This position is based on-site in either our Santa Barbara/Goleta, CA office, Arlington, VA office, or Reston, VA office.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with a cross-disciplinary engineering team to design, develop, and maintain reliable, fault-tolerant flight and payload software.
* Implement software to meet requirements while managing interfaces with multiple spacecraft subsystems and ground systems hardware.
* Develop command and control software for spacecraft flight operations, payloads, and peripheral electronics.
* Participate in and contribute to test campaigns, from unit-level testing to automated system and subsystem-level testing.
* Create and maintain documentation for software operation and interfaces with other system components.
* Take on additional professional duties as assigned.

  
**Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 3+ years of proven experience in high-reliability software development with **Rust** or C/C++.
* 1+ years developing concurrent code with **asynchronous Rust**.
* 3+ years of embedded software development with **Rust** or C/C++.
* Experience programming on embedded ARM cores supporting SoC architectures in Linux, RTOS, or bare-metal environments.
* Strong understanding of processor architecture, with the ability to optimize code for performance and memory usage.
* Experience leading software development processes, including version control, CI/CD, bug tracking, and design documentation.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, with 5+ years of relevant experience.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic development environment.
* Experience with software used in autonomous, fault-critical systems.
* Familiarity with Python programming.
* Background in developing, deploying, and maintaining software product lines.
* Knowledge of hardware interfaces such as Ethernet, SPI, I2C, UART, and PCIe.
* Experience with kernel development using Yocto.
* Knowledge of dynamics and control systems.
Able to travel up to 10-15%.

----------------------------------

LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears.

Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery.

LaunchDarkly's SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next-generation AI capabilities.

While autonomous machines offer significant advantages, they also introduce new safety challenges. FORT addresses these concerns by providing solutions such as the Wireless E-Stop, which allows operators to instantly stop any machine from a safe distance, enhancing safety during emergencies.

Additionally, FORT's Safe Remote Control enables operators to manage heavy machinery remotely, reducing the risk of accidents and improving visibility.

By ensuring communications integrity across any network, FORT empowers customers to protect their most valuable assets—people, data, and machines—ensuring they remain safe and secure.

As an Embedded Software Engineer II, you will own specific components of our embedded stack, working close to the hardware on the real-time firmware that our safety devices depend on. Most of your time will be spent in RTOS environments (Zephyr and FreeRTOS) and on bare-metal targets, architecting safety-critical systems where reliability is a hard requirement. You will also work with our Embedded Linux platforms where the two worlds meet, so you will be comfortable moving between constrained real-time targets and richer application environments.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build the Core:** Design and implement robust C/C++ firmware for safety-critical embedded devices.
* **Real-Time Architecture:** Architect and implement RTOS-based firmware on Zephyr and FreeRTOS, including task and scheduling design, ISR handling, inter-task communication, memory and stack budgeting, and deterministic timing analysis.
* **Bare-Metal and Drivers:** Write low-level peripheral drivers and board support code, and bring up new silicon from reset vector through to a running application.
* **Platform Integration:** Interface RTOS devices with our Embedded Linux user-space applications, ensuring reliable communication and consistent behavior across the product.
* **Pipeline & Quality:** Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) to automate testing, including on-target and hardware-in-the-loop test execution.
* **Hardware Integration:** Bring up new hardware, debug complex issues using JTAG/GDB, and optimize for latency, power, and memory footprint.
* **Safety Compliance:** Collaborate with the safety team to ensure code adheres to rigorous standards (IEC 61508) while maintaining development velocity.

**What You Bring**

* **Experience:** 3-5 years of hands-on embedded software development, with a substantial portion on RTOS or bare-metal targets.
* **Core Languages:** Strong proficiency in C, along with working proficiency in C++.
* **RTOS Knowledge:** Solid production experience with an RTOS such as Zephyr, FreeRTOS, ThreadX, or similar, including scheduling, synchronization primitives, and interrupt-driven design.
* **Microcontroller Fluency:** Comfort working directly with MCU peripherals, datasheets, reference manuals, linker scripts, and startup code.
* **Linux Exposure:** Familiarity with Embedded Linux user-space development, sufficient to integrate and debug across the RTOS and Linux boundary.
* **Connectivity:** Familiarity with IP networking protocols and standard interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, USB, CAN).
* **Tooling:** Experience with Python for scripting/automation and familiarity with CI/CD workflows.
* **Debugging:** Comfort using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG, and GDB to troubleshoot hard-to-find bugs.
* **Education:** B.S. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with Zephyr specifically, including devicetree, Kconfig, and west-based workflows.
* Experience with wireless stacks (BLE, ISM, Wi-Fi) on constrained devices.
* Background in Functional Safety (FuSa) or working in regulated industries (Medical, Automotive, Aerospace).
* Low-level Linux knowledge of Board Support Packages (BSP) and device drivers.
* Familiarity with static analysis, MISRA C, or other coding standards used in safety-critical development.

#### **Compensation & Benefits**

**Base salary range:** $120,000–$150,000, based on experience and location.  
**Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited PTO; stock options; 3% 401(k) match, paid holidays, and parental leave.  
**Application window:** Applications accepted through the end of December 2026. This date will be updated if the window is extended.

FORT Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

FORT Robotics uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team review and organize applications. These tools do not make hiring decisions; all decisions are made by FORT employees. To request an accommodation or a review without these tools, contact HR@fortrobotics.com.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Our Mission:**

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

**Our People:**

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

**Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Platform**  
**Location:** San Francisco Bay Area or Austin, TX (Hybrid)

**About the Role**
------------------

6sense has agents and an MCP server in production today, used by real customers. This role takes them further by building more capable agents, strengthening the API and tool layer, and expanding an ecosystem that external agents, clients, and partners can connect to.

You'll work across the full path from a customer's agent to 6sense data and actions, including APIs, tools, MCP, orchestration, context, evaluation, and security.

6sense is working to become the default Contextual Intelligence layer for B2B, and agents and MCP are how that context reaches customers, partners, and their AI tools. You'll partner closely with the team building contextual intelligence, write production Python daily, own multi-month projects, support the teams and customers who depend on these systems, and keep the platform current as the agent tooling landscape evolves.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Agents and Orchestration**

* Extend LangGraph orchestrators with typed state, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointing, durable execution, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Select and implement routing, orchestrator-worker, plan-and-execute, reflection, and multi-agent handoff patterns based on business needs.
* Run agents headless through API-first and MCP-first architectures across in-app, chat, workflow, and partner surfaces from a shared core.
* Build and maintain reusable components for state management, memory, tool-calling, and agent-to-agent delegation with scoped permissions.

### **APIs, Tools, and MCP**

* Evolve the APIs and tools agents use to access 6sense data and take action for both human and LLM consumers.
* Optimize tool design for agent success, including naming, descriptions, schemas, response formats, error handling, and token efficiency.
* Re-design and scale the MCP layer for production workloads, including concurrency, per-tenant quotas, latency budgets, caching, graceful degradation, backward compatibility, and adoption of emerging MCP capabilities.
* Onboard external MCP clients, AI assistants, agent platforms, and partners. Develop integration guides and reference clients and define trust boundaries for third-party MCP server integrations.
* Strengthen platform reliability through idempotency, retries, rate limits, permissions, spend controls, and standards for tool contracts, versioning, and discovery.

### **Context and Evaluation**

* Partner with the Contextual Intelligence team to expose context through MCP, APIs, and tools, enabling a unified context layer across all customer touchpoints.
* Define and enforce contracts around returned data, freshness, provenance, and tenant and user-level access controls.
* Improve permission-aware retrieval and grounding through chunking, hybrid search, reranking, citations, context assembly, and memory management within token and latency constraints.
* Expand evaluation frameworks using golden datasets, tool-selection accuracy, tool-call accuracy, end-to-end task success metrics, regression testing, release gates, and context quality measurements.
* Enhance tracing and usage analytics while reporting on task success rates, tool-call precision, groundedness, latency, and cost efficiency.

### **Security, Privacy, and Trust**

* Make security a first-class consideration across every tool, API, agent, and MCP change.
* Review your own and teammates' work for vulnerabilities and security risks.
* Enforce tenant isolation and user-level authorization for all requests while maintaining short-lived, scoped credentials.
* Protect against prompt injection, tool poisoning, excessive agent autonomy, and data leakage through outputs, traces, and logs.
* Establish runtime guardrails around steps, tokens, execution time, and spend.

### **Customers and Engineering Excellence**

* Investigate and resolve customer-reported issues across agents, tools, models, and downstream systems.
* Participate in customer and partner technical discussions and support enablement teams through guidance, demonstrations, and documentation.
* Write design documents, evaluate trade-offs, conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and participate in on-call and incident response rotations.
* Stay current with developments in MCP, agent frameworks, and model capabilities, prototyping promising technologies and sharing evidence-based recommendations.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 5+ years of experience building and operating production software systems, with strong distributed systems fundamentals including idempotency, fault tolerance, backpressure, and failure recovery.
* 2+ years of experience building production LLM-powered systems, including customer-facing agents.
* Strong Python development skills and production experience with LangGraph or a comparable orchestration framework.
* Experience designing APIs and tool interfaces for LLM consumers, including schemas, descriptions, error handling, and tool selection optimization. Direct MCP experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience scaling customer- or partner-facing platforms, including authentication, rate limiting, versioning, and backward compatibility.
*

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
**About GridPoint**

GridPoint is a private equity backed technology leader with a mission to accelerate the world's transition to a sustainable future by creating an intelligent energy network of grid-interactive buildings. Our technology platform harnesses the power and potential within a building to deliver energy, operational, and resiliency benefits — spanning Fortune 500 enterprises, utilities, government organizations, and small businesses.

**About the Role**

GridPoint is hiring a Software Engineer II for the Application Firmware team. You will work in Elixir on the firmware running our in-building energy controllers, the layer between our bare-metal firmware and the GridPoint cloud.

The work varies. A device-side control feature one month, a telemetry pipeline the next, a field failure after that. The target does not vary: constrained hardware installed incustomer buildings, where memory, CPU, and network are all finite.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain features in our Elixir application firmware, from story to release
* Structure application services as OTP supervision trees with isolated, restartableprocesses
* Define and implement device control logic, scheduling, local data collection, andconfiguration
* Develop solutions that function within the memory, CPU, and storage limits of thetarget hardware
* Debug on real hardware: bench units, serial consoles, and logs from the field
* Maintain the interfaces to the GridPoint cloud for telemetry, control, and config sync
* Verify your own work on hardware before calling it ready to ship
* Work with stakeholders to define test plans and develop them alongside the solution
* Work with the Bare-Metal Firmware and Hardware teams on drivers, bring-up, andpower behavior

**Qualifications**

Required

* Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, orequivalent experience
* 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience
* Elixir, or strong functional programming experience and a record of picking up newlanguages
* Understanding of concurrent, fault-tolerant design: processes, message passing,supervision
* Enough embedded or systems background to design within hardware limits
* Comfortable debugging on physical devices, not only locally
* Git-based development and code review

Preferred

* Production Elixir and OTP; Nerves or similar
* Enough C/C++ to read embedded firmware and work with the bare-metal team
* Device telemetry, OTA update, or fleet management
* MQTT, Wi-Fi, cellular, or LoRaWAN
* Control protocols such as Modbus and BACnet, over both serial and TCP
* Energy management, building automation, HVAC controls, or commercial IoT
* Working alongside hardware and QA through bring-up and validation

**What Success Looks Like**

Level II is where an engineer delivers a feature end to end without close supervision. The first year should look roughly like this.

**Milestone** **What we expec**t

3 months Shipping scoped features through normal review; at home in the codebase and on bench hardware

6 momths Owning a feature area from design through field validation; taking part in release validation and triage

12 months Turning vague requests into designs the team agrees on; mentoring newer engineers; trusted to judge release risk

Annual Salary Range: $135,000 to $175,000

The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for an **AI Software Engineer**to join **MDLinx**, an M3 company.

MDLinx Mission: Transform Omnichannel from Message Delivery to Belief Engineering

MDLinx is on the path to transform its business and product line-up from endemic to omnichannel engagement model, aiming at fulfilling the promise of true omnichannel approach to pharmaceutical brand promotion – “right message to the right physician at the right time on the right channel”. Our goal is to provide pharmaceutical brands with best-in-class personalized HCP engagement programs across the wider media ecosystem, designed to accelerate disease state and brand knowledge penetration, lead generation, and customer conversion. Our ambition is to leverage an omnichannel approach to establish a new philosophy for physician engagement, shifting from delivery to belief engineering.

* Implement features that improve MDLinx and drive impact for its users, with the scope of independent ownership growing over time.
* Contribute to the design of software systems, and participate in the review of other engineers' code.
* Apply software engineering best practices, including automated testing, clean code, peer review, and documentation, to build maintainable and adaptable applications.
* Contribute to the performance, security, and compliance of MDLinx.
* Contribute to the repository context, conventions, automated tests, quality gates, and executable plans that make agentic coding reliable.

* Find repetitive or time-intensive engineering work that can move to AI-assisted or automated workflows, keeping human review where it protects quality, accuracy, and compliance.
* Troubleshoot bugs in pre-production and production, with support from senior engineers on the team.
* Work with people inside and outside engineering to meet team and company objectives.
* Contribute to projects that benefit M3 USA as a whole, collaborating across business units beyond your own team when the company needs it.

* Associate or bachelor's degree in computer science or a relevant field, or equivalent experience in software engineering.

* 1 to 3 years of software development experience. Internships, co-ops, academic project work, open-source contributions, and substantial personal projects count toward this.
* TypeScript and React, and Python. Working knowledge is sufficient; depth is expected to develop in the role.
* SQL and relational databases, and version control with Git.
* Familiarity with at least one major cloud platform. MDLinx runs on AWS, GCP, and Vercel, and you will not be expected to know all three coming in.
* Hands-on use of AI coding assistants, with the ability to describe where they helped and where their output needed correction.

* Quick to learn whatever technologies MDLinx uses; with AI assistance, learning speed matters more than prior familiarity with any one stack.

jobs.description:
**The Mission**

The MASY Group is seeking an experienced full-stack Software Engineer to support the continued development and expansion of MASY'S video training platform. It is a Java/JavaFX desktop application deployed on both Windows and macOS, with synchronized multi-angle video playback. The application performs well on Mac but has shown inconsistent performance on Windows – particularly pertaining to skipping and video playback. We are evaluating the best path forward, whether stabilizing the existing architecture, selectively retooling components, or transitioning to a more sustainable technology stack.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who can independently evaluate the existing codebase, recommend a practical technical path forward, and support ongoing development and video playback optimization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assess, develop, and maintain the existing Windows Java/JavaFX desktop application, with immediate emphasis on Windows performance.
* Package and deploy the application for use in locked-down government environments, including installation from the cloud or removable media.
* Build and optimize synchronized multi-camera video playback across multiple camera angles, including seeking, scrubbing, encoding, compression, streaming, and audio integration, and recommend end-user hardware/GPU minimum requirements.
* Design and maintain AWS infrastructure using EC2/containers, S3, CloudFront, IAM, and KMS, supporting secure content storage, upload, and distribution for potential deployment in AWS GovCloud.
* Develop backend capabilities supporting software licensing, seat management, administration, student metrics, and reporting.
* Maintain and enhance exiting mapping and GPS tracking functionality supporting live team and exercise views.
* Apply secure software-development practices aligned with government cybersecurity and compliance requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Must be a U.S. citizen.**
* Strong professional software-development experience.
* Experience developing and troubleshooting Windows desktop applications.
* Experience working with Java desktop applications; JavaFX experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience optimizing video playback, encoding, compression, or synchronization.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, including S3, CloudFront, IAM, and compute services.
* Experience developing backend services, APIs, and databases.
* Ability to independently assess, design, troubleshoot, and deliver production software.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting desktop applications across both Windows and macOS
* Experience with multi-stream video technologies such as FFmpeg, GStreamer, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with C#/.NET, or similar technologies for potential future modernization.
* Experience with AWS GovCloud.
* Familiarity with FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, DoD impact levels, or similar government compliance frameworks.
* Experience with GIS, GPS data, or mapping libraries.

jobs.title: Junior/Mid Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Junior/Mid SOFTWARE ENGINEER (1 to 5 years of experience)**

  
  

**Overview**

We're looking for a Software Engineer who can operate independently within an Agile team, take ambiguous requirements from concept to production, and bring architectural judgment to how we structure and process data at scale. This is not a developer from a particular tech stack, but rather a true software engineer who can and will work with any number of languages without restriction.

We are only accepting candidates currently residing in the state of Florida, preferably in the greater Tampa/St. Petersburg area, at this time.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Work within a Scrum/Agile team through the full sprint cycle — backlog refinement, sprint planning, capacity estimation, daily standups, sprint review, and retrospectives.

* Participate in requirement refinement sessions with product owners and stakeholders, turning ambiguous asks into well-scoped, estimable stories.

* Apply modern software design patterns and enforce separation of concerns across the codebase, ensuring components remain loosely coupled and independently testable.

* Design and build proofs of concept (POCs) to validate new approaches before committing to full implementation.

* Design and implement systems that handle structured (CSV, relational), semi-structured (JSON), unstructured, and schema-bound formats like Avro, including the tradeoffs between them for storage, processing and schema evolution.

* Contribute to big data architecture and design patterns — batch and/or streaming pipelines, data partitioning, and scalable processing approaches.

* Collaborate with UI/UX on interface design decisions, ensuring frontend implementation aligns with usability and design intent.

  
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience working in Scrum/Agile teams, including sprint planning, capacity estimation, and iterative delivery.

* Strong grasp of modern design patterns (e.g., strategy, factory, repository, observer) and the "separation of concerns" principle — able to explain not just what it is, but why it matters for maintainability and testability.

* Experience with UI/UX collaboration and requirement refinement.

* Hands-on experience with structured, semi-structured, unstructured, and schema-based data formats (CSV, JSON, Avro).

* Big data technology experience (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Hadoop ecosystem or equivalent) and associated design patterns.

* Demonstrated experience building and validating POCs.

* Experience designing and building microservices architectures — service decomposition, inter-service communication (REST/gRPC/event-driven messaging), API contracts and independent deployability.

* Strong understanding of data layer and persistence design patterns — repository pattern, unit of work, CQRS, data access layer abstraction, ORM vs. raw query tradeoffs, caching strategies and both relational (SQL) and NoSQL database design.

* Experience with cloud platforms — AWS, Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — including core compute, storage, and managed data services on at least one major provider.

**Desirable**

* Proficiency in one or more modern languages beyond your primary stack — Python, Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Rust, TypeScript/Node.js or C# — with the versatility to pick up new languages as project needs evolve.

* Multi-cloud exposure across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and familiarity with cloud-native patterns (containers, Kubernetes, serverless, managed data/streaming services).
