jobs.title: Software Engineer, Payment Interfaces
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.  
  
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  
  
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

#### **The Role**

Payment Interfaces builds and operates the APIs and services that power payment experiences across Block, including Square, Cash App, and Afterpay. Our systems process payment traffic worldwide, helping sellers accept payments and customers move money reliably and securely.

You'll design, build, and scale customer-facing payment APIs and the critical systems behind them. You'll bring experience in payments, lead complex projects from design through production, and help shape the team's technical direction. You'll learn the specifics of Block's products and payment processing on the job.

This is a hands-on engineering role with ongoing operational responsibility. Alongside building new capabilities, you'll maintain high-volume production systems, participate in on-call and incident response, and make improvements that prevent recurring problems. You'll use AI throughout your work while remaining accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of what you ship.

#### **You Will**

* Design, build, maintain, and scale customer-facing payment APIs with clear contracts, predictable behavior, and compatibility that developers can rely on.
* Lead complex projects end to end: clarify requirements, evaluate trade-offs, plan incremental delivery, and own testing, rollout, and ongoing maintenance.
* Operate critical payment systems serving worldwide traffic. Participate in the team's on-call rotation, investigate incidents, and follow through on fixes that improve reliability.
* Improve performance, observability, fault tolerance, and security. Use automation to reduce repetitive operational work and make systems safer to change.
* Work with product and engineering partners across Block to turn payment requirements into reusable capabilities.
* Use AI-assisted tools for design, implementation, testing, and debugging. Critically evaluate their output and help teammates adopt approaches that improve quality and delivery.
* Shape technical decisions within the team and develop others through design reviews, code reviews, documentation, and mentoring

#### **You Have**

* **Experience building, maintaining, and scaling customer-facing financial or payment APIs, together with a strong understanding of payments.** This is a requirement for the role.
* Experience designing and operating high-volume, highly available distributed systems where correctness, security, and reliability matter.
* An understanding of payment API concerns such as idempotency, retries, asynchronous processing, backward compatibility, and handling partial failures without compromising financial correctness.
* A record of leading complex engineering projects from unclear requirements through production, making technical trade-offs, and coordinating work with partner teams.
* Experience diagnosing production issues and improving systems through monitoring, incident response, and preventive engineering.
* Fluency with AI-assisted engineering tools and the judgment to validate generated code, protect sensitive data, and recognize when deeper investigation is needed.
* Clear written communication and experience helping other engineers develop their technical skills.
* A minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience

#### **Technologies We Use and Teach**

* Kotlin
* Go
* TypeScript
* AWS
* Kafka

We're working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and "fair chance" ordinances.  
  
We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible. **Want to learn more about what we're doing to build a workplace that is fair and square? Candidates may submit up to 9 active application

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Daymark Health is a value-based oncology company redefining the cancer care experience for patients, providers, and health plans. Daymark's comprehensive, personalized cancer care platform empowers patients with dedicated care navigation, symptom-focused support, behavioral health care, and social resources. Combined with evidence-based health interventions and a hybrid in-person + virtual care model, Daymark is improving the overall cancer experience for patients, providers, and health plans – and setting a new standard in cancer care.

Daymark's groundbreaking approach is led by CEO Dr. Justin Bekelman, a pioneer in transforming cancer care, alongside some of the nation's foremost leaders in oncology and value-based care. Daymark Health is backed by Maverick Ventures, Yosemite, Oncology Ventures, Healthier Capital, Blue Venture Fund, and Healthcare Foundry.

*Be cautious of recruitment fraud, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Daymark Health email.*

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Software Engineer at Daymark Health, you will contribute to our technical strategy, build secure and scalable infrastructure, and play a key role in the development of our core product. You will work closely with our other engineers, product, and data teams, operational leadership, and external customers to shape a transformative cancer care experience across the stack. We expect you to hit the ground running and help bring our product to market:

* **Build alongside a strong team:** Contribute to the development of our cancer care platform, with an emphasis on user experience, workflow integration, and security. You'll need to move fast, so comfort with tools like Claude, Cursor, and openness to experimentation will help our team build and operate more efficiently.
* **Technical execution:** Collaborate with operations, product, data engineering, and analytics to build the core systems and tools that enable our care team to serve patients as efficiently and effectively as possible.
* **Security & compliance**: Follow secure development practices and handle protected health information (PHI) with care, working within the HIPAA and SOC 2 controls our team maintains.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* **Strong technical foundation**: You have 2+ years of experience designing and building user-centric products, and you write code you're proud to have reviewed. You're comfortable working across the stack and picking up unfamiliar parts of a system. Our stack uses python and AWS managed services (EventBridge, Lambda, DynamoDB).
* **AI-native builder:** You're fluent with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and actively incorporate them into your workflow to move faster and write better code. You see AI-assisted development as a core skill, not a shortcut.
* **Healthcare experience**: Familiarity with healthcare technology, including EHRs and interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7), is a plus.
* **Action-oriented**: You move with purpose and urgency, thriving in environments where speed and adaptability are crucial. You know how to prioritize and execute effectively in a fast-paced setting. We're early on in our journey and move quickly – we expect you to do the same.
* **Clear communicator**: You can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Customer-focused**: You enjoy engaging directly with customers, understanding their challenges, and leveraging their feedback to improve the product. You're comfortable explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and adjusting solutions based on real-world feedback.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity**: Startups are unpredictable, and you're skilled at adapting to rapid changes, balancing competing priorities, and navigating evolving business landscapes.

**Additional Information**

The expected compensation for this role is $145,000 to $160,000 annually, depending on location & experience.

This role is fully remote.

*Daymark Health is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*All Daymark Health patient-facing roles require Basic Life Support (BLS) certification and compliance with Daymark's Employee Vaccination and Testing policy. Candidates without these at the time of hire should coordinate with their recruiter and hiring manager to ensure they meet the requirements by their start date.*

*All roles that require in-home visits to patients must provide proof of a valid driver's license.*

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

Commerce7 (part of the Fullsteam organization): We believe that above price and product, the number one reason why a consumer chooses a brand is customer experience. Customer experiences that are customer-centric lead to loyalty, customer happiness, and ultimately drive sales and profit. Our mission at Commerce7 is to empower wineries with the tools and insights needed to deliver exceptional customer experiences and succeed in DTC.

We are looking for a **Frontend Engineer** who is passionate about building high-quality, scalable experiences on the web. You are results-driven, detail-oriented, and thrive on collaboration with a team that values openness and pushing the bar. You will work closely with product, backend, and QA teams to design and maintain user-facing applications across our suite of products, including ecommerce tools, a point of sale system, reservation software, and CRM. Our tech stack is Node.js, React, and AWS, with libraries such as React Router, Redux, and Styled Components. Development is fast-paced, with continuous feature releases and improvements.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Architect, build, and scale customer-facing applications across the Commerce7 platform, including point of sale, e-commerce, reservation, and CRM tools.
* Collaborate closely with backend engineers to understand and integrate with system APIs, ensuring smooth feature delivery and minimal rework. Partner with QA to ensure features are production ready.
* Improve, refactor, and maintain existing UX/UI, enhancing usability, and responsiveness across the platform.
* Ensure frontend code follows modern coding practices, industry standards, and internal conventions
* Participate in code reviews, promoting best practices for code quality, maintainability, performance, and scalability.
* Contribute to technical documentation for frontend workflows, component libraries, and UX patterns to support cross-team collaboration.
* Champion a culture of customer-focused UX/UI, consistency, and quality throughout the product.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Experience developing large-scale frontend applications with a solid understanding of frontend architectures and state management.
* Desire to own code quality and user experience, with a commitment to delivering excellence and meeting high QA standards.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and QA teams.
* Understanding of fundamental UX principles for the web.
* Curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
* A deep empathy for the user and a desire to learn about how they use Commerce7.
* Experience with ecommerce or point of sale platforms is a bonus.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver frontend features on schedule
* Proficient in JavaScript (ES6+) and React, with experience using Webpack, Babel, NPM, or similar build tools.
* Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and preferably styled components or component-based styling.
* Experience integrating with REST APIs
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)
* Experience with testing frameworks, including automated integration and unit testing.

**Salary range: $102,000-$117,500 CAD**

Fullsteam recognizes that your health and wellbeing are a priority. This is why we offer a full suite of benefits that include:  

* Medical
* Extended Health and LTD plan
* Dental
* Vision
* RRSP (with employer match)
* Health Spending Account
* Flexible paid time off

This posting is for an existing vacancy and will remain open until filled.

Fullsteam supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience, and background. Fullsteam is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Front End Developer
jobs.description:
**Role**

A **Front End Engineer** at GCS is an expert-level developer responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the user interfaces for enterprise applications. Utilizing modern front-end frameworks and a strict adherence to Atomic Design principles, this role ensures our application architecture is modular, scalable, highly performant, and intuitive. Working closely with product and backend engineering teams, you will architect and build complex UI components and partner with our design team to ensure the design is properly codified using front-end development best practices.

**Responsibilities**

* **Component Architecture:** Architect, write, and maintain reusable, highly modular UI components utilizing Atomic Design methodologies to ensure a consistent and scalable design system.
* **Front End Operations:** Manage complex state management and seamless data flow across enterprise web applications to ensure synchronized and highly responsive user experiences.
* **Performance & Optimization:** Build and maintain highly performant frontend architectures with automated testing, optimized rendering pathways, and a relentless focus on delivering a seamless, high-performing user experience.
* **User Experience & Delivery:** Deploy and manage user-centric interfaces, ensuring strict cross-browser compatibility, responsive design, and fluid animations.
* **Security & Accessibility Support:** Implement robust front-end security measures at the code level (e.g., Content Security Policy, XSS prevention, data sanitization) and enforce strict WCAG accessibility standards across all components.

**Requirements**

* **Front End Technical Mastery:** 5+ years of dedicated hands-on experience architecting, building, and troubleshooting enterprise-scale web applications.
* **Framework Expertise:** Advanced proficiency with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, or Angular), including custom hooks, advanced state management tools, and enforcing frontend best practices.
* **Atomic Design & UI Architecture:** Deep understanding of component-driven architecture, Atomic Design principles, and experience building or maintaining robust design systems.
* **Web Technologies:** Practical experience mastering modern CSS, HTML5 semantic markup, and modern web APIs.
* **Testing & Automation:** Strong abilities in testing frameworks and integrating frontend builds into CI/CD deployment pipelines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Accessibility Framework Experience:** Prior experience implementing and auditing front-end code for strict accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.1 AA+.
* **Enterprise Integration:** Experience building user interfaces for complex enterprise software or workflow automation platforms.
* **Workflow Automation & State Machines:** Proven track record of leveraging finite state machines and complex state architectures to drive sophisticated front-end automation, real-time data syncing, and dynamic forms.
* **Security & Governance Tooling:** Experience using automated security scanners and linters embedded into Git workflows to catch frontend vulnerabilities and structural misconfigurations prior to deployment.

Pay: $2,500.00 - $3,500.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Front-end development: 5 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: Remote

Great lawyers serve their clients best when they can focus on legal practice, not on troubleshooting their case management system, tracking medical records, dealing with accounting headaches, or managing marketing campaigns. Atticor handles the complex machinery of the modern legal business, liberating top-tier lawyers to do what they do best: practice law.  
  
Atticor was built by legal entrepreneurs who revolutionized mass claims litigation at scale and built technology and operational infrastructure that has served over 1.5 million clients and generated over $3 billion in gross recoveries, comprising a Case Acquisition Engine, Decision Infrastructure, Agentic AI Workflow & Operations, and an Institutional-Grade Backbone.

**About the role**

Atticor Group LLC is hiring a **Marketing Web Developer** to **build the landing pages and websites** that drive client acquisition across a portfolio of national legal brands. This is a **front end** **role** first. You will own how our pages look, load, and convert.

You will sit **inside the marketing team**, not an engineering org. Your work ships fast, gets tested against live paid traffic, and is measured by conversion rate and cost per signed case. If you love pixel-level craft and also care whether the page actually performs, this is the job.

Full stack skills are welcome, but we are hiring for front end excellence. A great candidate is the person a designer and a media buyer both want on their project.

This is a **full-time, remote** role reporting to our Director of Marketing. Compensation for the position includes an annual base salary of $140,000 to $160,000, commensurate with experience, plus the role is eligible for a year-end discretionary bonus and benefits.

**What** **you'll** **do**

* **Build landing pages at volume.** Design and develop high-converting campaign pages in Unbounce and custom HTML/CSS/JS, often several per week across multiple brands and case types.

* **Build and maintain brand websites.** Develop new pages, templates, and features on WordPress (custom themes).

* **Ship A/B tests.** Build page variants, partner with media buyers on hypotheses, and iterate based on results.

* **Protect performance.** Hit Core Web Vitals targets on mobile, where most of our traffic lands. Optimize images, scripts, fonts, and third-party tags.

* **Implement tracking correctly.** Work in Google Tag Manager, fire pixel and server-side conversion events, and preserve attribution parameters (UTMs, click IDs) through every form submit.

* **Translate design into code.** Turn Figma files, mockups, and rough briefs into polished, responsive, accessible pages without hand-holding.

* **Build reusable systems.** Create templates, component libraries, and build standards so the next page ships faster than the last.

* **Use AI tooling to move faster.** Use tools like Claude Code to accelerate builds while holding a high bar for the code that ships.

**What you bring**

* 4+ years building production websites and landing pages, with a portfolio of live work we can click through

* Expert HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript proficiency: You can build a polished, responsive page from scratch without a framework

* Strong visual eye. You notice spacing, type, and hierarchy problems before a designer points them out

* Hands-on experience with a landing page platform (Unbounce, Instapage, Webflow, or similar) and its limits

* WordPress theme development experience (PHP templates, custom fields, hooks)

* Mobile-first mindset and a track record of fast pages (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals)

* Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Google Ads conversion tracking, and GA4

* Experience building and debugging forms: validation, hidden fields, spam prevention, and third-party integrations

* Conversion rate optimization experience: you have run A/B tests and can talk about what won and why

* Comfort with Git and a basic deploy workflow

* Speed and judgment. You can turn a brief into a live page in a day or two and know which details matter

* Clear communication with non-technical partners: media buyers, designers, attorneys, and intake teams

**Nice to have**

* Full stack experience: Node.js, Next.js or React, REST APIs, SQL, Supabase or similar

* Server-side tracking (Meta Conversions API, Google enhanced conversions, server-side GTM)

* Background in legal, healthcare, financial services, or another regulated, lead-gen-heavy industry

* Figma or design skills strong enough to produce a page without a designer

**What success looks like**

**First 30 days.** You have shipped your first live landing pages, learned our build standards and tracking setup, and can launch a standard campaign page without help.

**First 60 days.** You own the landing page queue. Media buyers come to you directly, pages go live on schedule, and tracking fires correctly the first time.

**First 90 days.** You have improved the system itself: faster templates, better mobile performance, and at least one A/B test win that measurably lifted conversion rate.

Atticor Group LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Atticor is an Equal Opportunity Employer. For California residents, you will receive our CCPA information on your application confirmation page.

jobs.description:
**Contract Web Developer — Front-End Focused**

Freelance · Project-by-project · Fully remote

**Location:** Fully remote (U.S.)

**Engagement:** Contract, hourly

**Rate:** $50–$75 / hour

**Focus area:** Front-end development for client websites & web applications

**Please submit your application directly through our portal. To ensure fair and equal evaluation, applications sent via direct email or LinkedIn message will not be reviewed.**

**﻿**

**ROLLING APPLICATION — NOT A SINGLE OPENING**

We accept applications continuously. This is not a posting for one position. Work comes in as our client projects do, so the need may be immediate or it may be months away. We keep every application on file and reach out when a project matches what you do.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are building a bench of contract developers we can call on as client work comes in.

We are looking for a front-end focused web developer who is comfortable working across the stack. You will build the interfaces our clients' customers actually use — new sites, single-page web applications, and feature work on sites already in production. You do not need to architect back-end systems, but you should be able to work confidently against one: consume REST APIs, read and write SQL, and work in PHP well enough to know where a problem is coming from.

Dynamic Digital modernizes outdated technology, builds on proven frameworks, and delivers efficient development that helps our clients grow with confidence. We are a small team, the feedback loop is short, and what you build goes live for real clients.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Build responsive front-end interfaces in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript using React or a comparable framework, working from designs we provide.
* Integrate front ends with RESTful APIs, databases, and third-party services.
* Develop and customize WordPress themes and plugins, and work carefully inside existing client sites.
* Contribute to single-page web applications from scope through launch.
* Write and tune SQL queries, and work comfortably in PHP against an existing back end.
* Maintain and improve sites already in production — diagnosing issues, resolving bugs, and improving speed.
* Write, test, and maintain high-quality code across multiple projects.
* Review every line you ship, including anything produced with AI assistance, for correctness, quality, and security.
* Work closely with our team — account management, design, and leadership — to deliver work clients are happy with.
* Test before deployment and follow current standards and best practices.
* Create and maintain clear technical documentation for the systems you build and touch.
* Work from written scopes provided by the account team, and flag scope changes early — before the hours are spent.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* 2–7 years of professional web development experience
* Strong front-end skills: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a modern framework (React, Vue, or Angular)
* Experience consuming and integrating RESTful APIs
* Working knowledge of SQL (MySQL or PostgreSQL)
* PHP. Much of our client work runs on WordPress, so PHP is required, not a nice-to-have.
* Enough back-end familiarity to work against an existing server-side codebase without needing it explained
* Working knowledge of WordPress theme and plugin development
* Solid understanding of version control (Git)
* Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools. You are accountable for what you ship with them: AI-generated code gets the same review for quality and security as anything you write by hand.
* Ability to work independently and deliver functional solutions with minimal oversight
* Clear written communication — most of our coordination is asynchronous
* Availability for occasional scheduled calls during Eastern business hours
* A portfolio and a GitHub account we can review. Formal degree not required.

**PREFERRED**

* Node.js
* TypeScript
* Deeper back-end or architecture experience
* WooCommerce or Shopify
* CI/CD pipelines
* Hosting, DNS, and cPanel
* SEO fundamentals and Core Web Vitals
* Accessibility standards (WCAG)
* Working from Figma designs

**HOW THE ENGAGEMENT WORKS**

* Independent contractor (1099). You invoice us; you are not an employee of Dynamic Digital.
* Hourly at $50–$75, depending on experience and the work. Rate is agreed before each project.
* Project-by-project. No minimum hours are guaranteed, and we do not ask for exclusivity.
* Applications are accepted on a rolling basis. Being accepted to our bench is not a commitment of work by either side.
* Every project is scoped in writing — deliverables, hour estimate, and deadline — before work begins.
* Fully remote anywhere in the United States. Our team is in Willow Grove, PA and works Eastern hours.
* You control your own schedule, tools, and how the work gets done.

Dynamic Digital is a web development agency in Willow Grove, Pennsylvania, managed by Sahajanand, LLC. We modernize outdated technology and build on proven frameworks so our clients can grow with confidence. Small team, short feedback loops, and the work you build goes live for real clients.

Pay: $50.00 - $75.00 / hour

Job Type: contract

Education: No education required

Work location: This is a remote position

**Software Engineer — Full-Stack (Front-End Focused)**
======================================================

**About the company**
---------------------

A fast-growing, fully remote FinTech SaaS company sitting at the intersection of payments and data intelligence — the product helps merchants, and the software platforms they rely on, manage and reduce the cost of processing electronic payments. The team is small, close-knit, and genuinely AI-forward: engineers use agentic development tools day to day, and the culture leans toward mentorship and real autonomy over rigid process. It shows in retention — the engineering team's average tenure runs about four years, with zero voluntary attrition.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring a Software Engineer to join a small, high-trust engineering team and take real ownership of the front-end product experience. This is a full-stack role that is heavily front-end weighted in practice — you'll spend most of your time in the UI layer, with occasional backend exposure. You'll be this team's first dedicated front-end hire reporting to the front-end lead, so there's a genuine opportunity to shape how the role and the front-end practice grow from here.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own front-end features end to end — from UI/UX implementation through shipping — using JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and React (Vite as the build tool).
* Work on outlying UI services that consume shared backend services and present data to users, ramping toward independently handling most non-architectural tickets (form changes, UX changes supporting new backend features) within your first few months.
* Collaborate with a small backend-leaning engineering team (Java/Scala/C# exposure is a plus, not a requirement) to integrate front-end work with core product services.
* Use AI development tools as a normal part of your workflow — the team actively encourages this — while being able to verify and stand behind your own understanding of what you ship.
* 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, with genuine depth in JavaScript/TypeScript and React; Vite experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

LakeFusion is seeking a **Software Engineer - Backend** to build and scale our real-time API to enterprise production workloads. This is a deeply technical role focused on building resilient, fault-tolerant, high-throughput distributed systems that bridge enterprise backends with high-performance Python microservices and data lakehouse platforms.

A critical dimension of this role: we ship into customer environments. You won't just write code that works on our infrastructure — you'll build systems robust enough to run across Azure, AWS, and customer-managed Kubernetes clusters where you don't control the network, the identity provider, the observability stack, or the operator. That requires a particular kind of engineering discipline: defensive design, strong observability, minimal environmental assumptions, and thorough testing under failure conditions.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Scale the real-time API: Own the architecture and implementation of our high-throughput, low-latency API built in Python/FastAPI and deployed on Kubernetes.
* Maintain enterprise core: Develop and maintain core enterprise backends using .NET / C#, ensuring seamless interoperability between .NET services, FastAPI microservices, and NoSQL datastores.
* Build for resilience and fault tolerance: Design for graceful degradation under upstream failures, rate limits, partial outages, and retry storms. Eliminate silent failure modes.
* Engineer for autoscaling: Tune Kubernetes autoscaling behavior (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler) to handle bursty production workloads across diverse customer environments.
* Optimize NoSQL data stores: Architect and optimize MongoDB collections, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategies, and asynchronous database connections for low-latency queries.
* Build streaming integrations: Develop streaming pipelines and background execution workflows that sync data between service, transactional, and analytical layers.
* Integrate Lakehouse analytics: Connect backend APIs with Databricks compute, Delta Lake tables, and Unity Catalog to expose real-time analytics and data pipelines to downstream consumers.
* Design for portability: Architect services that ship into customer environments and work reliably without serverless dependencies, with customer-controlled identity, restricted network egress, and varied observability stacks.
* Own performance: Profile, benchmark, and optimize for latency and throughput. Understand and tune the full stack — from FastAPI event loops and .NET memory management through connection pooling, caching, and downstream service calls.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 2+ years of backend engineering experience building production-grade services and microservices.
* 2+ years of deep Python expertise, with hands-on mastery of FastAPI, ASGI server tuning (uvloop/Uvicorn), async event loops (asyncio), Pydantic, and performance profiling.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in .NET Core / .NET 6+ (C#), building RESTful APIs, Dependency Injection architectures, Entity Framework Core, and enterprise backend components.
* 2+ years of experience working with MongoDB, including schema design, aggregation pipelines, index tuning, and asynchronous drivers (Motor, PyMongo).
* Strong Kubernetes experience, particularly around autoscaling (HPA, KEDA), resource allocation, containerization (Docker), and production deployment patterns.
* Resilience and fault-tolerance engineering: circuit breakers, retries with backoff and jitter, bulkheads, timeouts, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns.
* Deployment portability experience: you understand how to write software that runs in environments you don't control and can adapt to restricted network egress and custom identity providers.
* Strong observability instincts: structured logging, metrics, tracing (OpenTelemetry), and the discipline to make systems debuggable from the outside.
* Excellent technical communication, with experience collaborating across distributed engineering teams.

**Nice-to-have**
----------------

* Databricks experience: Familiarity with Databricks Connect, Delta Lake, Spark SQL, or MLflow integrations.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS EventBridge).
* Experience deploying into enterprise customer environments with strict security/compliance constraints (customer-managed identity, private networking, private endpoints).
* Experience with dual-paradigm data access patterns bridging SQL and NoSQL/Document databases.

**About LakeFusion**
--------------------

LakeFusion is the modern Master Data Management (MDM) company. Global enterprises across industries ranging from retail to manufacturing and financial services rely on the LakeFusion platform to unify, govern, and deliver trusted data entities such as customers, products, suppliers, and employees. Built natively on the Databricks Lakehouse, LakeFusion creates a single source of truth that powers analytics and AI. LakeFusion enables organizations worldwide to accelerate innovation with trusted and governed data.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Security Focus
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on full-stack Software Engineer who will focus primarily on security remediation. Your first priority will be owning the remediation of vulnerabilities identified through penetration testing: not just reporting findings, but digging into the codebase, session traffic, and infrastructure to fix the underlying issues and prevent them from recurring. You will work closely with engineering and design teams to translate real-world security findings into concrete, testable requirements in our Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs), and you will personally implement or oversee the fixes.

This is an engineering role first. As the security backlog comes under control, you will have the flexibility to contribute to application development across our Ruby on Rails and React platform, bringing a security-minded perspective to the features you build.

Key ResponsibilitiesSecurity Remediation

* Vulnerability Remediation: Own end-to-end remediation of vulnerabilities surfaced by penetration tests and other security assessments, from triage through verified fix.
* Traffic and Session Analysis: Use browser-based code inspection tools to examine session traffic between the front end and back end, identify cases where excessive or sensitive information is being exposed, and translate those findings into concrete design and engineering requirements.
* TRD Input: Feed vulnerability findings and remediation requirements directly into the Technical Requirements Document (TRD) process so fixes are captured as durable design requirements, not one-off patches.
* Session Management: Review and harden session management practices across the application stack.
* Full-Stack Remediation: Work within a Ruby on Rails and React codebase and across containerized services (AWS, Fargate) to implement fixes at both the application and infrastructure layers.
* API and Real-Time Systems: Assess and secure real-time and API-driven features, including those built on Pusher and AnyCable, and RESTful APIs generally.
* Documentation: Produce clear, thorough documentation of vulnerabilities, root causes, remediation steps, and verification results.
* Compliance Support: Contribute security context and vocabulary to FedRAMP-related discussions and requirements, partnering with compliance and engineering stakeholders.

Application Development

* Feature Development: Design, build, and ship features across the Ruby on Rails back end and React front end alongside the broader engineering team.
* Secure by Design: Apply what you learn from remediation work to new development, helping the team avoid reintroducing known classes of vulnerabilities.
* Code Quality: Participate in code reviews, testing, and technical design discussions, with an eye toward both security and maintainability.

  
**Requirements**  
Engineering Experience

* 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with broad full-stack work across multiple applications and technology layers.
* Working proficiency in Ruby on Rails and React.
* Experience with containerized environments, AWS, and Fargate.
* Solid API experience, including RESTful API design and security considerations.
* Hands-on experience with Pusher and AnyCable, or comparable real-time messaging technologies.
* Knowledge of Ruby data models and how schema and query design affect performance and scalability.

Security Experience

* 5+ years of experience in a security engineering or closely related role.
* Proven experience remediating vulnerabilities identified through penetration testing.
* AWS Security certification(s) (e.g., AWS Certified Security – Specialty).
* General familiarity with FedRAMP: enough understanding of the vocabulary and framework to contribute meaningfully to a FedRAMP-related project.

Analytical Skills

* Comfortable using browser developer/code inspection tools to inspect network and session traffic.
* Able to identify when too much information is being exposed between backend and frontend, and to explain the risk clearly to engineering and design stakeholders.
* Able to translate security findings into actionable design requirements that feed directly into the TRD.

Coding and Technical Skills

* Working proficiency in Ruby on Rails.
* Experience with containerized environments, AWS, and Fargate.
* Solid API experience, including RESTful API design and security considerations.
* Solid understanding of session management principles and common pitfalls.
* Hands-on experience with Pusher and AnyCable, or comparable real-time messaging technologies.
* Broad, full-stack experience across multiple applications and technology layers.
* Knowledge of Ruby data models and how schema and query design affect performance and scalability.

Documentation

* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document vulnerabilities, remediations, and technical requirements clearly for both engineering and non-engineering audiences.

Nice to Have

* Experience with Pulumi for infrastructure as code.
* Python experience.
* SQL skills.
* Active or eligible for security clearance.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
The financial industry is growing at a record pace, but our data providers are still stuck in the past — with cumbersome onboarding processes, complicated APIs, slow infrastructure, and expensive licensing costs.

Databento is the market data platform for modern finance. The company provides real-time and historical data across futures, options, and equities through a unified API. By owning the entire market data stack end-to-end, Databento is the first platform of its kind to combine the performance and reliability demanded by the world's leading trading firms with a dramatically simpler developer experience. Our team includes alumni of Two Sigma, Citadel Securities, Flow Traders, Tower Research, PDT Partners, SIG, and other top quantitative firms.

We're looking for a midlevel or senior IC to join our Backend Engineering team as a Site Reliability Engineer. You'll own the uptime, performance, and observability of our platform, and help set the standard for how the rest of engineering builds, ships, and monitors software.

The range of problems is wide. You'll work on petabyte-scale data processing, SaaS problems like customer management and billing, and the query systems that power our APIs. Unlike most finance firms, we're open about our tech and how we build it.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own uptime, SLAs, and SLOs across our API and platform services.
* Set reliability and operational best practices for other developers without slowing them down.
* Build and maintain observability across logging, metrics, and tracing.
* Design and run high-availability deployment and containerization strategies.
* Profile and optimize Python applications for throughput, latency, and cost.
* Debug production issues down to the OS level using tools like strace, perf, eBPF, ss, and gdb.
* Improve deployment and CI/CD workflows.
* Join the on-call rotation, lead incident response, and run post-incident reviews.
* Find what needs fixing on your own, then take projects from idea to completion.

### **Preferred background**

* Full-time experience in SRE, DevOps, or backend engineering, preferably at a trading firm, tech company, or high-growth startup.
* Hands-on experience with observability tooling for logging, metrics, and tracing (e.g. Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, VictoriaMetrics, Jaeger, Logstash, Loki, Vector).
* Experience with containerization and high availability deployment (e.g. Docker, Podman, Docker Compose, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes, k3s).
* Strong proficiency in Python, including application development and performance optimization.
* Comfortable with Linux debugging and profiling tools such as strace, perf, eBPF, ss, and gdb.
* A track record of measurable impact in a recent role, such as improving performance by X%, speeding something up Nx, or saving $Y per year.
* Experience with alerting and incident response best practices is a plus.
* Familiarity with configuration management or infrastructure-as-code tools (Ansible, Terraform) is also helpful.
* Bonus if you've done HTTP benchmarking, load testing, and capacity planning.
* Database schema design and query optimization skills are nice to have.
* Good communication skills and work ethic for a remote workplace.
* An interest in financial data or algorithmic trading.

We offer health, dental, disability, and life insurance benefits, as well as 401(k) matching for full-time employees. We accommodate 100% remote work, with teammates living around the globe and paid in their local currency.

The base salary range for this role is $150,000–$215,000, benchmarked to Tier 1 locations in each country. Total compensation may also include bonuses, commissions, and equity, depending on the role.

Be cautious of phishing scams impersonating Databento that offer fake job interviews and request purchases. Official emails come only from **@databento.com** or **us.greenhouse-mail.io** (our ATS). Any other domains (e.g., databento-careers.com, databento.online) are fraudulent.

jobs.description:
### **About Northbeam**

Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi-touch attribution, MMM+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser-accurate first-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.

We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast-moving, high-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.

We're a remote-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a **mid-level software engine**er who leans backend and enjoys building features end to end. You'll spend roughly 70% of your time on backend work and 20–30% on frontend, which gives you the ability to carry a feature across the stack rather than handing it off.

You'll help build out new products and capabilities as they grow — implementing backend services alongside the frontend components needed to deliver complete product experiences. That work could include contributing to our new incrementality offering as it expands into a scalable experimentation platform, helping build near real-time data infrastructure, or bringing AI into our marketing users' workflows. You'll work day to day with a cross-functional team of data scientists, product managers, and designers, and with senior engineers who will help you grow into larger architectural decisions.

### **Your Impact**

* Contribute to our new incrementality product as it grows into a reliable, repeatable experimentation platform.
* Help build near-real-time ingestion and processing capabilities as we move beyond batch workflows.
* Build AI-powered workflows that help marketers evaluate performance and act on insights.
* Improve connection-state systems and help extend the partner ecosystem across data ingestion and exports.
* Work on other product areas such as role-based access control (RBAC).
* Contribute to frontend work when needed to deliver complete experiences.

### **What You Bring**

* 3+ years of experience building backend services, APIs, and/or data processing systems in **Python.**
* Exposure to distributed systems or microservices, and curiosity about how larger architectures fit together.
* Experience working alongside product managers, designers, and data scientists, and owning your implementation through to production.
* Comfort in a fast-moving or early-stage environment where priorities shift and engineers pick up whatever the product needs.
* Experience taking defined product requirements and turning them into working, production-ready code.
* The ability to work through unfamiliar datasets and interconnected tables to investigate issues and trace dependencies, with support when the path isn't obvious.
* Working frontend experience with technologies such as React and TypeScript; **deep frontend specialization is not required.**
* Strong coding fundamentals and real problem-solving instincts, with AI used as an accelerator rather than a substitute for core capabilities.
* A generalist mindset and willingness to work across backend, frontend, pipelines, and infrastructure when the product requires it.

### **You may be a strong fit if**

* Most of your experience is in **data-intensive** backend engineering, but you have also shipped frontend work.

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.

In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.

**Interview Process**  
The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5-7 interviews total and requires around 5-8 hours of your time.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Software Developer - ArtDaily Platform Modernization
jobs.description:
Software Developer – ArtDaily.com Platform Modernization

**Company:** ArtDaily News Inc.

**Location:** Austin, Texas (Remote)

**Job Type:** Part-Time / Contract

**Compensation:** $25–$45 per hour, depending on experience

**Schedule:** Flexible

About ArtDaily

ArtDaily.com is a long-established international online newspaper covering art, museums, exhibitions, auctions, architecture, photography, archaeology, and the global art market.

Our website has operated for more than 20 years and currently uses a legacy ASP-based publishing system.

We are seeking a talented independent software developer to help us build a modern replacement for our website's backend and editorial publishing platform.

**This is primarily a software development and backend modernization project, not a visual redesign.**

The existing public-facing ArtDaily design should remain substantially unchanged.

Project Responsibilities

Develop a modern content management system that allows editors to create and manage articles, including:

* Headlines and subheadlines
* Article text and formatting
* Main and additional images
* Image captions and photo credits
* Categories and author/source information
* Publication dates and scheduling
* Homepage placement
* SEO information
* Sponsored/promoted content identification

Editors must be able to create, edit, preview, schedule, publish, unpublish, and search articles through a user-friendly administrative interface.

The project also involves migrating ArtDaily's historical content while preserving existing article URLs wherever possible.

Technical Requirements

Experience with several of the following is desirable:

* Backend web development
* Relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server)
* Content management systems
* APIs and data migration
* Modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python
* Cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, or similar)
* CDN, caching, and website performance
* Cloudflare or comparable security solutions
* Backups and disaster recovery
* Git version control, testing, and documentation

We are open to different modern technology stacks, including Python/Django, Node.js/TypeScript, modern .NET, PHP/Laravel, or established CMS frameworks.

Ideal Candidate

We welcome experienced independent developers, talented recent graduates, and advanced computer science students.

We value demonstrated technical ability more than years of employment.

Candidates should be able to show real software projects they have built, explain technical decisions, and work independently.

Experience with legacy systems, content migration, or digital publishing is particularly valuable.

UT Austin students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

How to Apply

Please include your GitHub profile, portfolio, or examples of software you have personally developed.

Briefly answer:

* What is the most complicated web application you have personally built?
* Have you developed an administrative panel or content management system?
* What databases have you worked with?
* Have you deployed an application to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or another production server?
* How would you replace an old website backend while keeping the public-facing website largely unchanged?

Opportunity

This is a paid, project-based opportunity with the potential for ongoing work maintaining and improving ArtDaily after the initial modernization.

We are looking for a dependable, technically capable professional interested in building a long-term working relationship with an established international publication.

Language Requirements. We welcome applicants who speak Englesh and Spanish. Candidates may communicate and interview in either language.

Pay: $25.00 - $45.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

Description

We're reinventing how to attract and hire quality talent at scale — come join us.

We're seeking a Talent Marketing Manager to lead the strategy, execution and performance behind two of the AIM organization's most critical marketing functions: activation management and integrated marketing and campaign planning across Workforce Staffing's global hiring portfolio. This role starts with the customer: understanding hiring needs, translating them into marketing goals, and owning how those goals are achieved. You define how marketing support is prioritized, how campaigns are strategically planned, measured and optimized, and how the team scales its impact through automation, data-driven decisioning, and cross-functional orchestration.

You help thousands of people get a job every year.

As a marketing strategist and cross-functional operator, you set the vision for how activation logic, campaign planning, override management, and performance optimization work together to drive fill rate outcomes at scale across priority geographies globally. You translate complex performance data into decisive activation recommendations, manage daily pacing and spend governance, and own the narrative for senior leadership. You flex between deep-focus, data-rich environments and wide-focus, relationship-heavy environments with equal confidence.

You shape organizational strategy, build trust, drive clarity, and solve problems before they escalate.

Your insights don't just inform decisions — they define them. You influence partner team roadmaps and align business managers on fill risk strategy, and represent both the activation and campaign functions in cross-functional planning. You identify gaps between teams and processes, hold partner teams accountable for improvements, and build scalable mechanisms that outlast your direct involvement. You build the trust, mechanisms, and reporting that close the existing gap. You don't wait for perfect data — you make decisions with what exists and build toward what's needed.

Key job responsibilities

Performance Optimization & Marketing Strategy: Define the annual marketing strategy and plan the direction for channel mix, spend efficiency, fill rate improvement, and labor order trajectory across your portfolio. Lead quarterly strategy reviews, updating priorities based on performance data, market shifts, and evolving business needs. Partner with analytics teams to move beyond single-metric measurement to comprehensive campaign performance frameworks. Push back on media recommendations with data where channel performance does not support continued investment.

Activation Strategy & Risk Management: Own the strategic framework for weekly marketing activation logic across assigned markets, including application need and paid application need assessments. Define the override governance model, ensuring decisions are logged and structured to accelerate automation development. Set the standard for how risk is identified, escalated, and resolved across the portfolio.

Integrated Campaign Planning & Execution: Own annual integrated campaign plans for assigned markets, with focus on building and testing during low-volume periods and maintaining readiness for high-volume hiring events. Lead working-backwards planning from hiring projections, site capacity, and historical performance data. Consult senior leadership on quarterly strategy, budget allocation, and major campaign pivots. Translate changing labor order visibility into dynamic marketing adjustments, flagging risks and mitigation plans early.

Cross-Functional Orchestration: Drive collaboration with Performance Marketing, Journey Orchestration, Creative, Talent Engagement, Marketing Analytics, and Business stakeholders. Manage stakeholder expectations across business partners, country leads, and global teams. Bridge the gap between marketing capabilities and operational hiring realities. Manage a wide portfolio of countries with varying levels of data maturity, labour order certainty, and stakeholder sophistication.

Pacing & Spend Governance: Oversee daily pacing reviews, implementing ramp-down or pause decisions when application delivery targets are met. Share insights with Performance Marketing to improve paid marketing efficiency. Own escalation thresholds and spend decision governance.

Stakeholder Communication & Alignment: Own weekly and monthly Business Review deep dive presentations for senior leadership, translating risk sites and marketing performance into clear strategic narrative. Maintain regular alignment with Business Managers and cross-functional partners on fill rate risk and marketing actions. Influence investment priorities and partner team roadmaps through data-driven business cases. Application Quality & Fill Rate Improvement: Monitor performance against goals including fill rate, non-paid application share, spend per hire, and application-to-usable application ratios. Implement data-driven optimisations for underperforming sites. Identify quality gaps (geo-targeting, shift messaging, channel mix) and coordinate with Paid Marketing, Creative, and Owned Marketing teams to resolve. Own the activation logic that balances cost efficiency with fill rate delivery.

Automation & Process Improvement: Identify, develop, and drive adoption of mechanisms that improve activation efficiency, reduce manual override volume, and accelerate the path to automated decisioning. Own the automation of campaign planning processes — from discovery through recommendation to implementation. Eliminate redundant workflows and hold partner teams accountable for process improvements across both functions.

A day in the life

Your morning starts with reviewing overnight pacing data across your markets and making activation decisions for the day. You join the weekly reporting call with your stakeholders, leading the marketing view for your area with a clear recommendation for each at-risk site. Mid-morning, you're on a stakeholder call with business partners in Brazil translating application pacing risk into language they understand and building alignment on marketing levers available. After lunch, you're deep-diving a high-spend site in Germany where channel efficiency has dropped — pulling site-level data, identifying the issue, and producing an internal discussion analysis for the Paid Marketing team. In the afternoon, you're working through quarterly initiatives with other teams — defining what to learn, which markets to test in, and how results will inform next quarter's strategy. Later, you prepare the MBR narrative for senior leadership, connecting this month’s activation decisions to fill rate outcomes. You close the day connecting the dots: what patterns are emerging across your portfolio, what's working, what needs to change, and how to translate that into the quarterly strategy update you're presenting to leadership next week.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Ads Marketing
jobs.description:
Description

Come build the future with us! What unites all Amazonians (across teams and geographies) is that we are all striving to delight customers and make their lives easier, whoever that customer may be. In pursuit of delighting customers, Amazonians have developed many products and services that transformed the way our customers live their lives and run their businesses. Together, we are building the future, one innovative product, service, and idea at a time.

Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, publishers, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions—including retail media, display, video, DSP, measurement, and ad tech solutions—leverage Amazon's innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys.

We're seeking a strategic and customer-obsessed Product Marketing Manager to join our Ads Product Marketing team. In this role, you'll serve as a critical bridge between product development and go-to-market execution, translating complex advertising solutions into compelling narratives that resonate with advertisers and drive product adoption at scale.

As a Product Marketing Manager, you'll partner closely with Product Management, Go-to-Market, and cross-functional stakeholders to shape product strategy through deep customer insights and competitive intelligence. You'll own the end-to-end marketing lifecycle—from informing the product roadmap through voice-of-customer research to crafting positioning and messaging that differentiates our solutions in market. Your work will directly influence how thousands of advertisers discover, adopt, and maximize value from Amazon Ads products.

The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with creative storytelling, thrives in ambiguous environments, and has a proven track record of launching products that achieve measurable business impact. You'll need to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, moving seamlessly from conducting advertiser research to developing sales enablement materials to presenting product vision to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities

Collaborate with Product Managers to align on customer research priorities that will inform the product roadmap.
Conduct in-depth research and competitive analysis to identify the most promising opportunities for Amazon Ads products.
Communicate the product vision and direction to internal and external stakeholders to drive buy-in and adoption, establishing a regular cadence of stakeholder engagement.
Partner with Product Managers to recommend customer feedback prioritization, support effective Alpha/Beta testing, and refine the strategic roadmap.
Align GTM strategy to the product roadmap, translate complex product information into simple and clear language, and continue to gather customer feedback post-launch to inform future iterations.
Develop single-source-of-truth documentation to enable sales and marketing with positioning, messaging, product availability, best practices, implementation guides, and FAQs.

About The Team

The Ads Product Marketing team within Amazon Ads is the strategic connective tissue between product innovation and market impact. We don't just launch products, we shape how advertisers discover, understand, and derive value from Amazon's advertising solutions across the full funnel.

The Commerce pod sits at the heart of this mission, owning product marketing for some of Amazon Ads' core solutions: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Brand Stores. Together, these products serve millions of advertisers globally from small businesses running their first campaign to the large brands.

This role is part of the Sponsored Products & Sponsored Brands (SPB) product marketing team. We are evolving the PMM function beyond traditional launch communications to earning a seat at the table to directly influence the product roadmap through voice-of-customer research, competitive intelligence, and deep advertiser insights. Our work spans the full marketing lifecycle: from shaping what gets built, to how it's positioned in market, to driving adoption and measuring impact post-launch.

You'll join a collaborative, fast-paced team that partners daily with Product Management, Go-to-Market, Sales Enablement, and cross-functional leadership. We operate with a builder mentality by testing, learning, and iterating to deliver solutions that move the needle for advertisers and for the business. If you're passionate about translating complex ad tech into compelling stories that drive real outcomes, this is the team for you.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience communicating results to senior leadership
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
Experience in marketing or marketing research

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Berkshire Hathaway Direct Insurance Company (biBERK) is building a cloud-first, API-driven insurance platform that enables small business owners to buy commercial policies directly online. We are seeking an analytical and technically minded Marketing Analyst
to join our team in Stamford, CT, to help scale our digital marketing analytics and performance reporting framework.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of growth marketing, data science, and web applications. You will leverage modern AI coding environments (such as Claude, Copilot) alongside core digital tracking tools (Google Ads, GA4) and Python/R web application frameworks to build real-time interactive dashboards. Your efforts will directly inform marketing investment, optimize digital acquisition funnels, and track key operational metrics for senior leadership

This job is hybrid with mandatory in-office days at our Stamford, CT location on a weekly or monthly basis depending on location.

Job Responsibilities

Production Dashboard Engineering: Design, deploy, and support interactive analytical applications and custom web tools using Python (Streamlit) or R (Shiny). Build reporting systems to track direct-to-business marketing metrics, including quote-to-bind ratios, channel attribution, conversion velocities, and other funnel metrics. Use AI to build and maintain these dashboards on an azure environment.
AI-Accelerated Development: Serve as a functional champion for generative AI tools (Claude) within marketing operations. Utilize LLM workflows to accelerate code synthesis, automate data pipelines, and refactor analytical scripts to streamline dashboard delivery timelines.
Cloud & Data Integration: Partner with internal technology teams within the Azure ecosystem to integrate marketing data streams, support data warehouse migrations, and ensure secure deployment of analytical web applications.
Tracking Architecture & GA4 Optimization: Maintain and enhance digital analytics architecture across GA4 and Google Ads. Oversee custom dimension setups, event-driven tag management, and clean B2B lead attribution to ensure high data integrity across all digital channels.
Growth Experimentation & Media Testing: Design, run, and evaluate rigor-based media testing frameworks to measure true marketing incrementality. Execute Conversion Lift studies, Geo-Testing / Match-Market models, and A/B experiments across digital channels.

Requirements

Experience: 3–5 years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, or business intelligence. Experience in B2B commercial insurance, financial services, or insurtech environments is strongly preferred.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or Data Science.
Location: Must reside within a viable commuting distance of our Stamford, CT office to attend required monthly strategy and team alignment session.
Development & Analytics Stack: Advanced proficiency in Python (Streamlit) and/or R (Shiny) for web application development and data visualization. Deep expertise in GA4 (event tracking, custom dimensions) and Google Ads management platforms. Hands-on experience using Claude/LLMs for code generation, workflow automation, and refactoring.
Database & Cloud: Foundational understanding of the Azure ecosystem for data storage, query optimization, or web application hosting.
Testing Methodologies: Proven understanding of statistical media testing, specifically Conversion Lift testing, Geo-Testing, and A/B experimentation architectures.
Preferred Skills: Prior experience with traditional enterprise BI platforms (Power BI or Tableau) is a plus.

About Us

biBerk is where commercial insurance buyers can obtain coverage for their businesses from insurers of the Berkshire Hathaway group of Insurance Companies, one of the best capitalized insurance groups in the world. Our ultimate parent, Berkshire Hathaway Inc. (berkshirehathaway.com) is a holding company with diversified interests in a host of industries, including insurance, energy, transportation and manufacturing. Most policies issued through biBerk.com will be underwritten by Berkshire Hathaway Direct Insurance Company ("BHDIC"), which is an AM Best rated A++ insurer.

BHDIC is domiciled in Omaha, Nebraska. BHDIC and the team at biBerk are focused on helping small business owners quickly and easily buy affordable insurance directly from a financially strong insurance company they can trust.

BHDIC is excited to announce our comprehensive benefits package with some new and enhanced features for 2026 that include:

Medical (PPO/HDHP), vision, disability, and life insurance.
Enhanced dental plan with orthodontia coverage in addition to a standard plan.
Generous PTO plan for all benefit-time eligible employees.
Paid company holidays and 4 floating holidays.
Paid parental leave.
Employee Retirement Savings Plan/401(k) with company match and immediate vesting.
Education Assistance Program that offers 100% upfront tuition reimbursement after 6 months of service for approved degree programs.
Service Recognition Program that provides a monetary award to be used toward a vacation every 5 years of employment.
Wellness Initiatives that include Fitness Center and Weight Watchers Reimbursement programs.
Voluntary benefits that include accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity.
Employee discount and rewards program on travel, tickets, electronics, home, and more.

Final compensation will be based on candidate qualifications, geographic location, and other considerations permitted by law.
