**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role/Department:** Strategist, Demand Generation & Performance Marketing/Digital Marketing

As Asset Management and Asset Servicing continue to evolve their digital marketing and demand generation capabilities, this role will play a key part in building a more connected, automated, and measurable approach to audience engagement. The position will support the design and execution of marketing automation programs, including campaign orchestration, nurture journeys, lead management, segmentation, testing, and performance optimization. The role partners with marketing, sales and business stakeholders to translate business objectives into scalable, data-driven marketing programs using Marketo, Salesforce and connected platforms. The strategist will oversee the build, launch and optimization of multi-channel campaigns. including managing marketing data and platform processes; and deliver reporting and insights that improve engagement, operational efficiency and business outcomes. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with hands-on technical execution, strong data discipline, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**The key responsibilities of the role include:**

* Develop and implement demand generation strategies and campaigns for Asset Management and Asset Servicing using Marketo, Salesforce CRM, Salesforce Campaigns, Microsoft Dynamics and connected marketing technologies.
* Collaborate with cross-functional internal teams such as sales, product, content strategy, and marketing teams to increase brand awareness, develop customer relationships, and drive revenue.
* Develop and maintain automated nurture, onboarding, engagement, re-engagement and retention journeys across prospect and client lifecycle stages.
* Implement and maintain lead management processes, including acquisition, source tracking, scoring, qualification, routing, recycling and handoff to sales, in alignment with agreed service levels and governance standards.
* Maintain reusable program templates, tokens, forms, landing pages, smart campaigns and operational workflows that improve speed, consistency, and scalability.
* Maintain marketing data quality through standardized field usage, list management, segmentation, deduplication, normalization, consent management, and routine data audits.
* Monitor integrations and data flows between Marketo, Salesforce and connected platforms; troubleshoot sync, workflow and campaign-processing issues and coordinate resolution with technology, operations and data partners.
* Continuously test marketing tactics to improve results and drive innovation. Plan and evaluate A/B and multivariate tests for subject lines, content, audience, cadence and conversion experiences, and apply findings to ongoing optimization.
* Use data analytics and digital platforms to track and measure the performance of campaigns (conversion rate, acquisition, return on investment) and prepare detailed reports. Define campaign KPIs, create reporting and analyze performance across delivery, engagement, conversion, lead quality, client activity and business contribution; recommend optimization opportunities.
* Apply privacy, consent, accessibility, brand and records-management requirements to automated marketing programs and support audit-ready documentation.
* Perform platform administration and governance activities such as workspace and folder organization, naming conventions, user access support, program archiving and operational quality controls.
* Document campaign requirements, operational procedures, data definitions and quality-control standards, and provide guidance and enablement to marketing automation users.

**Required Qualifications**

* Requires 5 - 8 years of working knowledge and experience in performance marketing. marketing automation and/or demand generation. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or related field is highly preferred.
* Extensive hands-on experience using Marketo to build, test, deploy and optimize email, landing page, form, event, webinar, nurture, triggered and multi-channel programs
* Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud or Salesforce Financial Services Cloud and Microsoft Dynamics including campaign structure, lead and contact management, reporting and sales handoff processes.
* Working knowledge of audience segmentation, personalization, dynamic content, lifecycle automation, lead management, preference management and campaign attribution
* Strong data management skills, including data quality review, field mapping, normalization, deduplication, consent management and governance
* Excellent project management skills with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Excellent structured communication skills and the ability to explain marketing automation, CRM and data concepts clearly to business and technical stakeholders
* Strong quality assurance and technical problem-solving skills

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Marketo Certified Associate, Marketo Certified Expert or comparable marketing automation certification
* Experience supporting institutional Asset Management, Asset Servicing or other complex B2B financial-services

---------------

Sprig is building the AI-native successor to legacy survey tools, like Qualtrics, Medallia, and SurveyMonkey. We believe the future of experience research won’t be powered by slow, siloed platforms. It will be fast, intelligent, and deeply integrated into how modern teams build great products.

Our mission is to make deep customer understanding effortless and always on. With Sprig, product teams no longer guess. They know. We are creating a future where AI uncovers insights, accelerates workflows, and enables teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences in real-time.

Companies like Notion, Figma, Coinbase, and TripAdvisor already use Sprig to stay closer to their customers than ever before. We’re scaling quickly toward $100M ARR, launching new AI-powered capabilities, and expanding our impact across the world’s most innovative companies.

If you're energized by bold ideas, rapid growth, and the opportunity to redefine an entire category, we'd love to meet you.

**About the Role**

You’ll run your own programs across events, content, and campaigns, while managing our Marketing Associate, our Marketing Events Lead, and our Research Partners, the UX research experts who represent Sprig in the research community.

You’ll report to our Chief Revenue Officer and partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product to build pipeline, strengthen Sprig’s position as the AI-native alternative to legacy survey tools, and create memorable experiences for research and product leaders.

* 1-2+ years of experience managing, mentoring, or leading others, with a hands-on, player-coach approach

* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, including with Sales

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.

People in Corporate Functions make DXC a well-run and high-functioning organization. Each team contributes to DXC's success and each individual delivers world class service and has opportunities to grow and learn

DXC Technology is looking for a Manager, Global Brand Media to help plan, manage and optimize the paid media supporting our global brand strategy and campaigns.

Working as part of the Global Brand team, this role will be DXC's day-to-day media lead, partnering closely with our Senior Manager, Brand Creative & Campaign Strategy, internal Creative Studio, digital and analytics teams, and external media agency.

***About The Role****:*

The Media Manager will translate campaign objectives into effective media strategies across channels, audiences and markets, ensuring that DXC reaches the right enterprise decision-makers in the right environments and that our media investment is continuously measured and optimized.

This person will connect **strategy to activation**: managing agency plans, media budgets, audience and channel recommendations, creative media requirements, launch readiness, campaign performance and optimization.

The role requires someone who understands sophisticated B2B media but also enjoys the operational detail required to get campaigns into market successfully.

***What You´ll Do***

**Media strategy & planning**

* Translate DXC brand and campaign objectives into integrated paid-media plans.
* Support development of the annual and campaign-specific media strategy across global markets.
* Recommend the appropriate channel mix across premium video/CTV, business media, digital publishing, programmatic/display, LinkedIn, YouTube, audio, partnerships and account-based media.
* Help define the role of media across **awareness, preference, consideration and account engagement**.
* Develop audience strategies across senior business decision-makers, technology leaders, priority industries and strategic accounts.
* Connect broad brand media with vertical, ABM and retargeting activity to create a coherent audience journey.

**Media agency management**

* Serve as the day-to-day lead for DXC's external media agency.
* Develop clear agency briefs in partnership with the Brand team.
* Review and challenge agency recommendations across audience, channel mix, geography, investment, reach, frequency and timing.
* Manage weekly agency status, optimization and performance reviews.
* Ensure clear ownership between agency-managed and DXC-managed media.
* Track agency deliverables, media commitments and key campaign milestones.
* Escalate investment, delivery or performance risks where appropriate.

**Media investment & budget management**

* Maintain a clear view of media budgets, allocations and commitments.
* Track investment by market, audience, channel, publisher and campaign.
* Partner with the agency and internal teams to identify opportunities to reallocate investment based on performance.
* Support evaluation of publisher partnerships and new media opportunities.
* Ensure investment decisions can be clearly explained to Brand leadership.
* Partner with Finance and Procurement on media-related budget and commercial processes.

**Campaign activation & creative coordination**

This is where I would make the partnership with Siobhan very explicit.

* Translate approved media plans into clear **creative requirements, formats, specifications and delivery deadlines**.
* Brief Siobhan and the Creative Studio on what media requires, while Siobhan retains ownership of the creative response.
* Maintain visibility into media deadlines, asset readiness, trafficking and launch status.
* Ensure the media agency has the correct approved assets and landing destinations.
* Identify potential media or inventory risks early enough for the creative team to respond.
* Coordinate campaign readiness checkpoints across media, creative, digital and agency teams.
* Ensure media requirements inform creative development without allowing the media plan to dictate the creative idea.

**Measurement, optimization & learning**

* Define media KPIs and learning agendas with Brand, Analytics and agency partners.
* Monitor campaign performance across audiences, channels, publishers, markets and creative.
* Lead the day-to-day optimization dialogue with the media agency.
* Turn performance data into actionable recommendations on targeting, channel mix, investment and creative needs.
* Work with Siobhan to identify where creative performance suggests a need for new messages, formats or executions.
* Partner with Analytics to understand behavior beyond media delivery, including quality of traffic and on-site engagement.
* Develop clear, concise media-performance reporting for Brand leadership.

**Director, Paid Marketing & MarTech**

**The Opportunity**

Every paid dollar EcoShield spends to acquire a customer will run through you. You will be hands-on in the work while we grow the program and hire the team, building and optimizing campaigns yourself in the early innings. Your channels feed a National Inside Sales organization, so you will own paid media's contribution to marketing attributed revenue which is driven by qualified lead volume, connected leads, sales, and blended CAC.

* Strategy, execution, and P&L for all paid channels: paid search, paid social, display and video, Local Services Ads, retargeting, direct mail testing, etc.

You will partner with the CMO and other Marketing and Analytics leaders to build out this program.
* Measurement design in partnership with the Director, Marketing Data & Analytics: offline conversion feeds, value-based bidding, and incrementality testing so ad platforms optimize toward sold subscriptions rather than simply raw lead volume.

* Forecasting and reporting: paid lead and sales volume forecasts, with weekly performance reporting on spend, CAC, and ROAS.

* 4+ years in affiliate or partner marketing, with direct hands-on responsibility for a program's results.
* Demonstrated experience building or substantially scaling an affiliate program, ideally from scratch or from a basic state.
* Hands-on platform fluency with one or more major affiliate networks or SaaS platforms (Impact, Commission Junction, Awin, Partnerize, ShareASale, Rakuten Advertising, Everflow, or similar).

* Real budget, real backing. Direct line to a fully committed CMO and executive team.

**About Marketing.Storage**

Marketing.Storage is a digital marketing and technology company built exclusively for the self storage industry. We partner with storage operators to drive more rentals, revenue, and ROI through digital marketing, website strategy, reporting, and technology built for storage. With 16+ years and 4,000+ facilities behind our data, we take the guesswork out of marketing.

We are a remote team that runs on high trust and high accountability. We expect a lot, we support each other, and we make room for the good parts of team life along the way. If you are an owner who thrives on driving work to the finish, you will fit right in.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Brand and Growth Marketing Manager to own our brand and drive our own growth. You will work directly with our leadership and sales team on two connected fronts: keeping the Marketing.Storage brand consistent, organized, and strong, and leading the lead generation efforts that grow the business.

This role is about ownership. You will manage the work, set priorities, direct internal team members and outside partners, and make sure important brand and growth work gets planned, executed, and followed through. You will not execute every tactical task yourself. Our internal fulfillment team handles the hands-on marketing execution, so experience in SEO or paid ads is a plus but not required. What matters most is that you can own outcomes and keep momentum.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Brand management**

* Own the consistency of the Marketing.Storage brand across website messaging, decks, collateral, social presence, and sales materials.
* Apply and reinforce brand standards, voice, and positioning.
* Identify gaps in current brand assets and prioritize what should be created or improved.
* Make sure brand work is not just created, but organized, finalized, and put to use.

**Lead generation and growth**

* Manage our own lead generation efforts to drive more qualified storage operator opportunities.
* Direct campaigns across channels such as paid search, SEO, social, and website, working with our internal fulfillment team to build and improve them.
* Keep campaigns planned, launched, tracked, and improving over time.
* Keep channel strategy and messaging aligned with business goals.

**Email campaigns and nurture**

* Own promotional email campaigns, nurture flows, and drip sequences.
* Define goals, audiences, timing, messaging, and calls to action.
* Review results and improve engagement and conversion over time.

**Proof assets and sales support**

* Identify strong wins and partner results that should become case studies or proof pieces.
* Drive creation of case studies, one-pagers, and sales support materials.
* Keep these assets current, usable, and easy to find when the team needs them.

**Project ownership and coordination**

* Turn ideas into tracked projects with clear priorities, owners, timelines, and next steps.
* Keep work moving across the team and prevent important projects from stalling.
* Coordinate and direct outside brand and creative partners so their work stays aligned to priorities and timelines.
* Give leadership clear visibility into what is active, blocked, or needs attention.

**Trade show support**

* Share ownership in preparing for and managing our trade show presence.
* Coordinate booth materials, collateral, sales support assets, and related promotion so everything is ready and consistent.

**What We Are Looking For**

* An owner who takes responsibility for outcomes and drives work to the finish.
* Strong at prioritization, organization, and follow-through across many moving pieces.
* A proactive communicator who can direct internal team members and outside partners.
* Proven marketing experience, ideally owning projects or campaigns end to end.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable in a high-trust, high-accountability, fully remote environment.

**Job Description**

The Ashbrook Center, an independent center at Ashland University, seeks an accomplished and mission-driven Director of Marketing and Communications to lead its communications and marketing efforts as a member of its Philanthropy Team. Reporting to the Senior Director of Philanthropy & Strategic Partnerships, the Director will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive communications strategy that strengthens Ashbrook’s brand, expands its reach, and compellingly communicates the impact of its work to donors, partners, educators, students, and the broader public.
  
  
The successful candidate will be an exceptional writer and communicator, a creative and strategic thinker, and a collaborative leader who understands how thoughtful communications can deepen relationships and advance Ashbrook’s mission.

**KEY****RESPONSIBILITIES****:**

* **Strategy and Leadership:** Develop and execute a comprehensive annual communications and marketing plan aligned with Ashbrook’s strategic and philanthropic goals. Provide leadership and counsel on messaging, positioning, audience development, and communications opportunities.
* **Brand Management:** Protect, strengthen, and elevate the Ashbrook brand, ensuring consistency of voice, message, and visual identity across all communications, platforms, programs, and collateral.
* **Content and Storytelling:** Lead the creation and production of compelling content that brings Ashbrook’s mission and impact to life, including newsletters, annual and donor reports, publications, social media, press releases, website content, and other print and digital materials.
* **Digital Marketing:** Manage and strengthen Ashbrook’s digital presence, including email marketing, social media channels, website communications, and search engine optimization (SEO), with an emphasis on expanding and engaging Ashbrook’s audiences.
* **Media Relations:** Develop relationships with journalists and other members of the media, identify and pitch appropriate stories, coordinate media opportunities, and serve as a spokesperson for Ashbrook when needed.
* **Team and Vendor Management:** Supervise communications support staff and interns and effectively manage relationships with external agencies, designers, consultants, printers, and other vendors.
* **Analytics and Reporting:** Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for communications and marketing initiatives, using data to evaluate effectiveness, improve performance, and report results to senior leadership and the Board.
  

This role benefits from regular interaction with the Ashbrook team and therefore welcomes candidates who live in, or would consider relocating to, the Ashland, Ohio area. At the same time, we are open to exceptional remote candidates who share our mission and can maintain a meaningful presence with the team with regular visits to headquarters.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, English, or a related field is required.
* Ideal candidate will have five to seven (5 to 7) years of professional experience in marketing, communications, public relations, or a related field. Experience in the nonprofit sector is preferred.

jobs.description:
Lipscomb University is looking for a Performance Creative Strategist to own the creative strategy and execution behind our paid media campaigns.

You know the difference between a concept, an angle and a hook. More importantly, you know how to test each one.

You will research what prospective students care about, turn those insights into concepts and angles, and create work that earns attention in a category where a lot of advertising looks the same. We are looking for creative that goes beyond the expected student and campus shots, and familiar higher-ed formulas to show what makes Lipscomb distinctive.

You’ll create and build the ads, launch tests and use performance data to decide what comes next. What worked? Why? What needs a new hook? What should we iterate, scale or retire?

**Responsibilities:**

* Creative Analysis and Testing
* Conduct asset-level creative analysis weekly: what worked, why and what to do next. Tag winning elements (hook type, CTA style, format, visual approach) to build a learning library over time.
* Monitor key creative metrics including hook rate, hold rate, click-through rate, frequency and conversion rate.
* Build and maintain dashboards that track performance by concept, angle, hook, format, audience and program.
* Maintain consistent creative output: develop and launch new concepts, angles and hooks each testing cycle, balancing quality and volume.
* Develop a creative testing roadmap: Define hypotheses, set performance goals and determine whether to iterate, scale or retire creative elements.
* Use AI tools to streamline creative analysis: Analyze performance, identify trends and generate insights to focus more time on strategy.
* Present clear, actionable findings to University Marketing leadership.

**Audience Research and Concept Development:**

* Research prospective student motivations, objections and decision factors using admissions insights, CRM data, social listening, competitor and libraries and creative trends.
* Study channel trends, platform changes and emerging formats and apply to creative development.
* Use AI for audience research, competitive intelligence and trend analysis: turn information into actionable creative direction.
* Build a concept and angle library for priority programs and audiences, identifying competitive messaging.
* Build creative frameworks: develop distinct concepts and angles for key audiences, including firsttime undergraduate students, parents, transfer students, working adults and graduate prospects.

**Creative Angle Development and Production:**

* Translate priority concepts into multiple distinct, platform-specific angles.
* Develop hooks, headlines, ad copy, scripts and produce static, motion and video assets.
* Write clear, actionable creative briefs for designers, copywriters and videographers for highproduction assets that require specialized expertise.
* Ensure creative follows Lipscomb brand standards, reflects the University’s Christian mission and complies with platform policies.

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, communications, business, data analytics or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
* 2+ years of experience developing, analyzing or optimizing paid digital advertising creative assets.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookups and data cleanup.
* Fluency in creative performance metrics: hook rate, hold rate, CTR, frequency and conversion rate.

* Proficiency in analyzing, cleaning and visualizing data to identify actionable insights.
* Strong copywriting skills, including hooks, headlines, ad copy, calls to action and testable creative briefs.
* Experience scripting, storyboarding and producing static, motion and short-form video assets.
* Proficiency in using AI tools for research, ideation, creative development and analysis.

#### **Experience**

Required

Required

jobs.description:
Medical Marketing & Communications Specialist

**Contract | Project-Based | Remote**

About DocDelta

DocDelta is a healthcare market research firm that connects physicians, nurses, healthcare executives, patients, and caregivers with opportunities to participate in market research studies on behalf of pharmaceutical and research clients.

We work across diverse healthcare audiences, often reaching highly specialized populations within tight timelines. Clear communication, participant trust, and effective engagement are essential to our success.

About the Role

We’re looking for a **Medical Marketing & Communications Specialist** with a background in healthcare, medical, or pharmaceutical communications to help us build a scalable library of high-quality messaging.

In this project-based role, you’ll develop compelling, credible, and audience-specific communications that encourage engagement, improve response rates, and help participants move from initial outreach through screening, scheduling, and study completion.

You’ll work closely with our team to refine how DocDelta communicates across email, LinkedIn, our website, and other outreach channels. The goal is to create a consistent, professional brand voice while making our communications more effective, trustworthy, and engaging.

This is an opportunity for a strong healthcare communicator who understands how to reach busy clinicians and diverse patient populations without relying on generic marketing language or overly promotional messaging.

What You’ll Do

* **Develop a communications library:** Create reusable templates and messaging frameworks that our team can adapt across studies, audiences, and channels.
* **Improve study invitations:** Write compelling, concise invitations that capture attention and encourage qualified physicians, nurses, healthcare executives, patients, and caregivers to participate.
* **Strengthen referral messaging:** Develop clear, trust-building communications that make it easy and comfortable for healthcare professionals to refer appropriate patients or colleagues.
* **Optimize follow-up sequences:** Create reminders, confirmations, and time-sensitive messages that encourage recipients to complete screeners, schedule appointments, attend sessions, and finish studies.
* **Enhance participant engagement:** Explore creative, professional approaches to improve engagement, including progress cues, milestone messaging, peer-insight framing, and recognition where appropriate.
* **Elevate our brand presence:** Refine LinkedIn content, recruitment messaging, and website copy to strengthen DocDelta’s credibility and consistency.
* **Adapt messaging by audience:** Develop variations for physicians, nurses, healthcare executives, patients, caregivers, and other relevant audiences across email, LinkedIn, text, web, and advocacy-group outreach.
* **Establish messaging guidelines:** Document tone of voice, audience-specific considerations, recommended use cases, and customization guidance so our team can use the materials consistently.
* **Recommend testing opportunities:** Where appropriate, suggest ways to test subject lines, messaging approaches, and calls to action to identify what drives stronger engagement and conversion.

What You’ll Deliver

The primary deliverable will be a practical, organized **communications bank** that our team can use across ongoing and future projects.

Expected deliverables include:

* A messaging framework covering brand voice, tone, audience considerations, and trust-building principles
* Study invitation templates with variations in tone, format, and audience
* Healthcare professional referral request templates
* Reminder, follow-up, and re-engagement sequences
* Time-sensitive outreach and urgency-based messaging
* Participant confirmation, thank-you, and completion messaging
* LinkedIn content and outreach templates
* Website copy recommendations and/or revised copy
* Usage guidelines explaining when to use each asset and how to customize it for individual studies
* Optional recommendations for testing and measuring messaging performance

The final library should be organized, adaptable, and easy for our team to implement without having to start from scratch for each study.

What We’re Looking For

* Professional experience in medical, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or life sciences marketing and communications
* Strong copywriting skills, with the ability to balance credibility, warmth, clarity, and concision
* Familiarity with healthcare professional audiences and an understanding of what earns clinician trust
* Experience adapting messaging for different audiences, channels, and stages of engagement
* An understanding of healthcare communications compliance and ethical participant engagement
* The ability to translate business objectives into practical messaging that drives measurable action
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to build structured, reusable content libraries
* The ability to work independently, incorporate feedback, and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in healthcare market research, patient recruitment, clinical research communications, or expert recruitment
* Familiarity with physician and healthcare executive outreach
* Experience with email campaign optimization, A/B testing, or conversion-focused copywriting
* Experience developing messaging for patient advocacy organizations or sensitive health-related topics

Important Considerations

All messaging must meet high standards of accuracy, professionalism, and ethical communication.

* No misleading claims, unsupported statements, or promotional product language
* No undue pressure on participants or manipulative engagement tactics
* Compensation and incentive language must reflect the details of each study and applicable fair market value practices
* Messaging must accommodate studies where the pharmaceutical sponsor or client identity is not disclos

jobs.title: Designer - Brand & Marketing (Contract to Perm)
jobs.description:
Designer - Brand & Marketing (Contract to Perm)
===============================================

About Assured Allies
--------------------

Aging well is both a health question and a financial one, yet most people are handed those challenges separately. At Assured Allies, we believe the only way to truly age well is to address both.

We partner with insurance carriers to help their policyholders stay healthier and more independent for longer. Our member program, NeverStop, delivers personalized coaching and simple daily actions that help people take an active role in their health and longevity.

We’re building for two very different audiences: adults in their 60s and 70s who are engaging with NeverStop, and the carrier executives, partners, and investors who work with Assured Allies. Our brands need to feel connected while speaking authentically to each audience.

That’s where you come in.

The Opportunity
---------------

We’re looking for a Brand & Marketing Designer to help define and own how both Assured Allies and NeverStop show up in the world.

On the NeverStop side, you’ll take an evolving brand foundation and extend it across everything outside the product experience—from the marketing website and campaigns to sales materials, email, social, and other member-facing communications.

For Assured Allies, you’ll help shape how the corporate brand evolves alongside NeverStop. You’ll work closely with Marketing and Corporate Development to establish where the two brands connect, where they should be distinct, and how they can feel like part of the same company without becoming interchangeable.

This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll design, build, and maintain the work yourself, including our marketing websites in Framer. You’ll also create the systems, templates, and standards that enable the broader team to produce high-quality, on-brand work without needing a designer for every request.

We’re particularly interested in someone who understands that designing for older adults requires thoughtful craft: excellent legibility, clarity, accessibility, and warmth—without relying on the clichés or condescension that too often appear in the category.

We’re open to starting with a contract or part-time engagement, with a clear path to full-time. We’re looking for a long-term design partner who wants to take meaningful ownership of the function, not a project-based agency relationship.

What You'll Do
--------------

* Own and evolve the **visual expression** of the Assured Allies and NeverStop brands across marketing and communications.
* Extend NeverStop’s brand system across websites, landing pages, sales materials, email, social, campaigns, and other marketing surfaces.
* Help define and develop the relationship between the NeverStop and Assured Allies brands.
* Design and maintain marketing websites and digital properties, primarily using Framer.
* Create high-quality sales decks, one-pagers, reports, presentations, campaign creative, and executive-facing materials.
* Partner with Marketing and Corporate Development on campaigns, storytelling, presentations, and other high-impact creative work.
* Collaborate with our product designer to ensure member-facing program content remains consistent with the broader NeverStop brand.
* Build and maintain a library of templates, guidelines, and design standards that enable teams to create on-brand materials independently.
* Establish efficient processes for managing multiple design requests and priorities across Marketing, Product, Corporate Development, and leadership.
* Use AI-assisted design and content tools thoughtfully to improve speed and efficiency while maintaining a high bar for quality and brand consistency.
* Bring strong visual and typographic judgment to everything you create.

What You'll Bring
-----------------

* 5+ years of experience in brand, marketing, or visual design, ideally within a technology-focused company.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating range across brand systems, websites and landing pages, presentations, reports, digital content, and campaigns.
* Experience building, evolving, or extending a brand system across multiple channels.
* Strong hands-on web design and implementation skills using a no-code platform such as Framer, Webflow, or a comparable tool. Direct Framer experience is a plus.
* The ability to work comfortably across both B2C and B2B audiences, adapting the visual language and storytelling to each.
* Strong visual, typographic, and systems-oriented design skills.
* Excellent judgment around brand consistency, especially when working across many contributors and touchpoints.
* Experience collaborating directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
* The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, resource-conscious environment.
* A thoughtful perspective on designing for older adults, with an appreciation for accessibility, legibility, clarity, and inclusive design.
* Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve creative workflows and production efficiency, with good judgment about where AI adds value and where human craft matters most.
* A high degree of ownership—you’re comfortable identifying what needs to be done and taking it from concept through execution.

### Nice to Have

* Experience in health, wellness, longevity, healthcare, insurance, or a related space.
* Experience with video, motion design, or storyboarding.
* Experience as an early or solo designer at a startup or other resource-constrained environment.
* Experience working across multiple related brands or developing brand architecture.

Compensation & Location
-----------------------

This role is open to starting as a contract or part-time engagement, with a path to full-time based on mutual fit and business needs.

The role is remote within the U.S., with a preference for candidates in the Boston, MA area and consideration for candidates elsewhere on the East Coast.

jobs.description:
**About Nerdio**

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft Cloud and end user computing investments.

Deploying, managing, and cost-optimizing Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Intune is technically complex without a purpose-built management layer on top. Nerdio is that layer. We automate what Microsoft’s native tooling leaves manual, so enterprises and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) can run cloud desktops at scale with lower cost, less operational effort, and less migration risk.

Founded in 2016, Nerdio is used by more than 15,000 organizations in over 50 countries and was named Microsoft’s 2024 Americas Partner of the Year. Our vision is to be the control plane that makes Microsoft cloud workspaces simpler, more efficient, and cost-effective at scale. How much of that opportunity we capture depends on go-to-market execution.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for people who are collaborative, empathetic, driven, and who love to move at the speed of light.

**About the role**

Nerdio is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Field Enablement to be the connective tissue between Product, Marketing, and our direct and partner sales organizations. You will make sure sellers and partners understand our products, our positioning, and our customer value, and can use that story to drive better outcomes for sellers, partners, and customers.

You will partner closely with Nerdio’s Sales Enablement & Readiness team, which leads onboarding, training, certifications, sales methodology, and field execution for sellers and partners. As part of Product Marketing, you will create the messaging, positioning, competitive insights, and content that power these programs. Together, the teams will equip sellers and partners to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Nerdio solutions.

* **Build product-led sales content.** Create pitch decks, solution briefs, battle cards, customer stories, and ROI tools tailored to direct and partner motions.
* **Equip partners and co-sell.** Work with Partnerships and Partner Marketing to create partner-ready content that makes MSP, channel, and Microsoft co-sell motions repeatable.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

* Strong writing and content skills across PMM formats (battle cards, solution briefs, decks, launch kits).

You’ll own the social media engine that accelerates Prep Network’s subscription success — shaping how we speak, publish, and show up across all channels. You’ll guide the daily output for Prep Network's subscription brands, support new initiatives like Prep Scores, and collaborate with our event marketing team to maximize reach, strengthen storytelling, and drive meaningful growth.

You’ll build and manage the full social calendar for our digital brands, publish a high volume of engaging content highlighting our articles, rankings, features, and recruiting guidance. You’ll partner closely with video and graphics teams to turn ideas into scroll-stopping assets, and you’ll guide our digital social contributors and VAs with clear briefs, expectations, and posting standards.

**Who We Are**

Prep Network is a sports company that connects high school athletes with college coaches. Through our nine brands, we publish over 4,000 articles each month and actively scout talented athletes across the U.S. We aim to discover and promote promising prospects who aspire to play at the collegiate level.

In addition to our content, Prep Network is the top event operator in the U.S., hosting 200+ tournaments annually. We offer a combination of top-tier competitions and extensive media exposure for attending teams. Our 250+ showcases each year provide a platform for over 10,000+ prospects to compete in front of colleges, scouts, and media outlets.

We’re pumped to have been named one of the "Best Places to Work" by Minneapolis/St. Paul Business Journal for five years running, and to land a spot on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies. Prep Network isn’t your average sports company; we’re all about helping student-athletes succeed and creating an awesome workplace.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Plans and Publishes the Daily Content Calendar Across All Brands:** builds and runs the weekly calendar for multiple social channels across all brands, building brand awareness and promoting articles, ranking drops, recruiting and commitment news, scores and subscription features, engagement posts, and product updates.
* **Sets and Executes Brand Voice and Community Engagement Across Channels:** writes copy in each brand’s voice, defines tone and engagement standards, models them in day-to-day community engagement responding to comments and messages, and reviews team content for quality and consistency.
* **Shapes Briefs and Leads Asset Production with Video and Graphics Teams:** writes creative briefs, sets priorities and deadlines, and makes sure assets are ready ahead of publishing and events.
* **Manages Digital Social Contributors, VAs and the Coordinator:** recruits, trains, assigns work and holds the team accountable for output and quality.
* **Owns Performance Reporting and Leads Campaigns with Cross-Team Partners:** tracks and reports social metrics, uses the data to adjust strategy, and executes subscription and marketing campaigns with other departments.

**Must-Haves in a Candidate**

* **Social Media Mastery:** 2-3 years in social media strategy and execution for multi-brand or content-driven organization**s.**

* **Creative & Analytical Balance:** Strong copywriting and creative instinct, paired with comfort in reading performance data to iterate.

* **Brand Voice Stewardship:** Ability to craft and sustain a recognizable brand identity through content.
* **Collaboration:** Works seamlessly across departments — digital, video, graphics, events, and marketing.

**Nice-to-Haves in a Candidate**

* **Social Listening:** Proven ability to identify early platform trends and pivot content strategy quickly.
* **Multi-Brand Navigation:** Experience toggling between multiple voices or sub-brands without sacrificing consistency or clarity.
* **Tool Proficiency**: Knowledgeable in platforms such as Sprout Social (or a similar social media management tool), Asana, Google Workspace, and Slack.

**Work Eligibility**

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship. Only U.S. citizens will be considered for this role at this time.

**Benefits and Perks**  
At Prep Network, we take pride in our culture and commitment to creating an exceptional workplace environment. Here are some of the benefits and perks you can expect when you join our team:

* **Vibrant Culture**. Prep Network has been recognized as one of the Best Places to Work for five years running, thanks to our vibrant and inclusive culture. We’re passionate about bringing on board curious, self-motivated individuals who work hard and genuinely enjoy their work.
* **Autonomy.** We trust our team members to excel in their roles. Rather than micromanaging, we provide you with the tools and processes needed for success, allowing you the freedom to bring your role to life and make a meaningful impact.
* **Professional Growth.** We prioritize your professional development. We actively support and encourage you to invest in your personal and professional growth.
* **Comprehensive Benefits.** We offer comprehensive health benefits, a 401(k) with Safe Harbor matching, long-term disability, and Basic Life Insurance. Work arrangements are flexible; whether you're in our Plymouth, MN office or working remotely

jobs.title: SEO/SEM Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Location:** **Remote** 
**Employment Type:** **Full-time**
------------------------------------------------------------

Instrumental is growing, and we are looking for an SEO Specialist to help clients become more discoverable, measurable, and competitive across traditional and AI-powered search.

This is not a traditional marketing role. You will combine search strategy with hands-on technical implementation: auditing websites, improving organic visibility, configuring and validating analytics and conversion tracking, and helping clients understand how people find and engage with their businesses. You will also help clients adapt to AI-driven discovery through Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), prompt tracking, and practical visibility measurement.

You will work closely with clients and internal teams to identify opportunities, make or coordinate improvements, and connect search performance to meaningful business outcomes. The work calls for curiosity, precision, sound judgment, and a willingness to explain technical topics in clear, useful language. Search is changing quickly; we value people who can experiment thoughtfully while keeping the fundamentals strong.

**Who We Are**
--------------

Instrumental is a digital sales and marketing agency based in Golden, Colorado and a proud Elite HubSpot Partner. We partner with growth-minded organizations to build scalable, data-driven marketing and revenue strategies within the HubSpot ecosystem.

We show up unapologetically on our own terms. We lead with authenticity, build real relationships, and deliver exceptional work. There is a bit of Western frontier energy in how we operate. We are self-made, trailblazing, and committed to doing things the right way.

We are not the loudest in the room, but we earn trust quickly. Whether partnering with a Fortune 500 company, a CMO, or a founder building something from scratch, we meet people where they are and lead with a human-first approach. We care deeply about the craft behind a well-built HubSpot solution and the artistry behind a well-told brand story.

Our work speaks for itself. We have earned more HubSpot Impact Awards than any other agency because we stay focused on what matters most, delivering meaningful results that drive real client success. At Instrumental, high standards and strong culture go hand in hand. We support each other, take ownership, and take pride in the impact we create together.

**Who You Are**
---------------

You show up as your authentic self, grounded, prepared, and ready to contribute.

You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and communicate proactively. You ask thoughtful questions, build trust easily, and look for ways to improve both your work and the team around you.

You adapt your approach to meet people where they are, whether working with founders or enterprise-level leaders, without losing your authenticity. You value both discipline and creativity, and you care about doing things the right way.

You are organized, reliable, and able to balance multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of work. Most importantly, you care about your work, your team, and the impact you are making.

**How We Think About AI**
-------------------------

AI is part of how modern teams do great work.

At Instrumental, we expect a baseline of curiosity, initiative, and practical experimentation when it comes to AI. Our team members consistently look for ways to improve how work gets done, whether that means increasing velocity by reducing time to complete a task or elevating excellence by improving the quality, clarity, and usefulness of the outcome.

You do not need to be an expert, but you should be open to exploring and adopting new tools and ways of working. We see AI as a way to enhance thinking, not replace it, and as a key part of building a more intelligent, efficient, and high-performing team.

### **Job Responsibilities**

### **SEO Strategy and Implementation**

* Audit websites and search performance to identify technical, on-page, content, local, and authority-building opportunities.
* Conduct keyword, topic, intent, competitor, and search-results research; prioritize opportunities by relevance, business value, and likelihood of impact, not search volume alone.
* Build practical SEO roadmaps and execute or coordinate prioritized work, including metadata and heading updates, internal linking, URL and canonical improvements, redirects, content optimization, and local search enhancements.
* Investigate crawling, indexing, site architecture, mobile experience, Core Web Vitals, image, and page-performance issues; document findings and coordinate fixes with web, development, and client teams.
* Work with sitemaps, robots.txt, Google Search Console, HubSpot SEO tools, and site crawlers to help search engines discover and interpret important content.
* Recommend and support structured data and schema implementation, including JSON-LD, where it helps clarify entities, services, locations, and answers.
* Support website launches, redesigns, migrations, and domain changes by identifying search and measurement risks and validating key technical elements before and after release.

### **Analytics, Tracking, and Measurement**

* Set up, configure, audit, and troubleshoot measurement across Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, HubSpot, and related platforms.
* Translate business goals into a clear measurement plan: define key events and conversions, document what they mean, and align reporting across organic, paid, referral, and other relevant channels.
* Implement or coordinate tracking for forms, calls, booking or quote actions, cross-domain journeys, and other meaningful user interactions, based on the client’s systems and access permissions.
* QA tags, triggers, events, forms, and conversion paths to confirm that tracking fires as intended, avoids duplicates, and captures the right actions. Investigat

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Think Sensory**

Think Sensory is an online education platform for therapists, educators, and parents supporting neurodivergent children. We offer continuing education for pediatric therapists and educators, self-paced courses, printable resources, and articles. Think Sensory is an AOTA Approved Provider.

Our flagship program is the Think Sensory Summit, a virtual event featuring interview-style sessions with experts and advocates in occupational therapy, speech-language pathology, psychology, education, and the neurodiversity movement. Season 2 runs in November 2026. Three summits are planned for 2027, starting with a summit for teachers in the spring.

All of our work is grounded in neuroaffirming practice.

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Growth Marketing Analyst to drive insights and recommendations on marketing performance across our digital channels. This is an entry-level role, and recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

The role sits at the intersection of marketing and analytics. You'll translate campaign data into actionable insights that improve lead acquisition and conversion performance, using AI-enabled tools to speed up the analysis.

We're looking for a self-starter with a strong analytical mindset, a passion for learning and growth, and a shared commitment to supporting neurodivergent children.

We're a small, growing team, and this role will grow with the company.

You'll report directly to our President and work closely with our President and CEO.

**Key Responsibilities**

Campaign Performance and Insights

* Analyze performance across our digital channels, including paid social, email, and our website
* Help set performance targets and benchmarks, such as conversion rates, engagement, and the share of free registrations that upgrade to a paid pass
* Evaluate lead generation across channels, including volume, quality, and conversion through the funnel
* Identify the key drivers of conversions, cost per acquisition, and overall campaign results
* Translate findings into actionable recommendations, including improvements to audience targeting, messaging, and timing
* Report weekly to our President on performance, trends, and recommendations

Lifecycle and Retention

* Analyze the customer lifecycle across summits, including upgrade rates, retention, and repeat registrations
* Identify opportunities to re-engage past registrants and improve retention

Channel and Budget Support

* Monitor performance across our owned channels, including our website, email, and checkout
* Provide insight into channel performance to inform budget allocation
* Identify opportunities to scale high-performing campaigns or improve efficiency
* Support forecasting and performance planning

Marketing Support

* Schedule and support email and organic social campaigns, including summit launch sequences
* Respond to social media comments
* Assist with paid social campaign setup and monitoring

**Required Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in a field such as accounting, economics, statistics, math, business, marketing, or psychology
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, numbers, and large amounts of data
* Ability to translate data into clear business insights and recommendations
* Detail-oriented, with a strong focus on data accuracy and documentation
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Self-motivated, with the ability to take initiative and work with minimal supervision in a remote role
* Open to feedback and quick to learn new tools

**Preferred Experience**

* Previous experience in analytics
* Digital marketing experience, or exposure to tools like Meta Ads Manager
* A personal or professional connection to the neurodivergent community, such as lived experience, family, coursework, or work with children, and familiarity with neuroaffirming practices
* Experience at a startup or small business, including part-time jobs, internships, or campus roles

**The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is curious about what drives results and uses data to find the answer. They’re accurate and thorough, and they communicate findings clearly, including what isn’t working and what they recommend next.

They learn quickly, take ownership of their work, and adapt well in a small, growing company where priorities can shift quickly. They’re looking to build their skills in a role with real opportunity for growth.

They share our respect for neurodivergent people, and that respect shows in how they speak to and about our audience.

**How We Use AI**

Think Sensory is an AI-forward company. We support the use of AI tools to increase efficiency and productivity. In this role, that includes analyzing data, informing decisions, optimizing campaigns, and generating ideas.

The time AI saves goes back into creating content for our audience ourselves. Our ad copy, graphics, and emails are all written and designed by our team, and we expect them to be original and consistent with the Think Sensory brand.

**Work Arrangement**

* Fully remote, open to candidates across the United States
* Flexible schedule: set your own working hours, with availability for scheduled meetings with our President and CEO
* 30 hours per week, with potential to increase as we grow

**Compensation**

$50,000 to $58,000 USD based on 30 hours per week. Compensation is commensurate with experience.

**Application Requirements**

Please include the following with your application:

* Resume
* Cover letter telling us why this work interests you and any connection you have to the neurodivergent community

Think Sensory welcomes applications from neurodivergent and disabled candidates. Accommodations are available at any stage of the hiring process upon request.

Pay: $50,000.00 - $58,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Social Media Associate
jobs.description:
**About us:**

Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that's gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested **over $2 billion** in real dreams and real opportunity, spanning more than **100 countries** and **over 5 million** borrowers

As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values-driven and digital-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130+ full time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva's team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.

#### **Kiva's values:**

Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

Extreme ownership - Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.

Be curious and bold - Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.

jobs.title: Senior Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era**
=======================================

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce , Feedonomics , and Makeswift , we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

The **Senior Social Media Manager** owns the organic social media across our family of brands — Commerce, BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift — plus social support for select members of our leadership team.

  

This is an ownership role, not a support role. It sets the strategy, builds the calendar, makes the content, publishes it, and answers for the numbers. Partners with Creative, PR, Demand Gen, Content, and Product Marketing teams, but it shapes and owns the Social Media program.

  

The person who does well here is a strategist who is also fast with their hands. They can build a quarter-long narrative for our brands, and can also turn a keynote clip into a live post the same afternoon without waiting on anyone.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

**Strategy And Planning**

* Own a documented organic social strategy for each brand, with a clear point of view on what each channel is for and which audiences it serves (customers, prospects, partners, analysts, candidates, employees).
* Maintain a rolling four-week content calendar covering every brand and channel, extended and refreshed weekly, visible to stakeholders.
* Set and defend the content mix: executive video, customer stories, product and platform news, events, recruiting, and reactive commentary.
* Bring a quarterly plan to leadership that connects social activity to brand, demand, and communications goals.
Work alongside a new social selling agency we will deploy  

  

**Content Creation And Publishing**

* Write and edit for social: captions, threads, short-form video scripts, and executive posts that hold each brand's distinct voice.
* Produce your own assets. Use Canva, CapCut, or similar to make images and cut short-form video so that routine content ships without waiting on a design queue. You'll partner with Design on higher-craft, campaign-level work and on reusable templates for recurring post types.
* Build repeatable content series and consistent visual formats rather than one-off posts.
* Publish across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube, adapting format and framing to each platform rather than cross-posting. You will have a point of view on what content should go on each channel.
* Monitor and evaluate additional or emerging channels and make recommendations about where we should activate.

**Speed On Moments that Matter**

* For events, launches, and known milestones, have content and creative prepared in advance so posts can happen in the moment.
* Cover live moments such as keynotes, events, internal all-hands, offsites, etc. yourself and capture raw video and photos to capitalize on those moments and momentum quickly.
* Monitor news, industry reports, and cultural moments for places our brands and executives can credibly add something.

**Executive And Employee Social**

* Draft, schedule, and manage social content for select senior leaders.
* Identify commentary opportunities where an executive perspective lands better than a brand post.
* Run the employee advocacy program end to end: recruit participants, supply content people actually want to share, and grow participation.

**Measurement**

* Own the numbers. Define the KPIs that matter per channel and per brand, and report monthly on what performed, what didn't, and what you're changing as a result.
* Identify top-performing posts each month and use format testing to make deliberate decisions rather than posting on habit. More volume is not the goal; engagement and impact are.
* Use Sprout Social, Google Analytics, and potentially additional tools to inform reporting.

**Brand Safety And Standards**

* Every post gets a human read for accuracy, relevance, messaging alignment, and voice before it goes out. Attention detail is a must.
Uphold brand standards across all social touchpoints, monitor for social media policy issues, and partner with PR and Community on crisis response.  

  

**Who You Are**

* 5+ years in social media strategy and content creation, in-house or agency, with B2B tech experience preferred.
* You've owned a program, not just a queue. You've set the agenda somewhere rather than executing someone else's calendar.
* You are genuinely online. You understand LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube as distinct cultures, not as distribution endpoints, and you know how audiences get built.
* A strong, versatile writer who can move between brand voice and executive voice without flattening either.
* Hands-on with short-form video and design tooling such as CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, Canva, or equivalent. You can shoot on a phone and cut something good.
* Comfortable with analytics and honest about them. You can walk into a room, say a campaign underperformed, and explain what you're doing differently.
* Organized under real load. Multiple brands, multiple calendars, competing stakeholders, and you don't lose the thread.
* Proactive by default. You surface the problem and the proposed fix before someone else notice

Sprinto is an **Autonomous Trust Platform** that centralizes trust requirements across **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve **raised** **$31.8M** in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over **4,000 organizations across 75 countries**, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With **300+ native integrations** and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports **200+ global security standards natively**, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

**Founded in 2020** by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

### **Life as a Sprinter -**

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

### **The mission -**

Some of our most valuable customer conversations begin in a room: a CISO dinner, a founder meetup, a practitioner roundtable. Your mission is to turn those conversations into a predictable, growing source of pipeline for Sprinto.

You’ll own our global field marketing strategy across the **US, EMEA, and APAC**, reaching startup and SMB founders as well as mid-market security, GRC, and IT leaders. You’ll decide where we show up, whom we bring together, and where every field dollar goes.

### **Where you'll leave your mark?**

Reporting to the **Head of Marketing**, you’ll sit on the Marketing leadership team and lead **three regional field marketers** covering US Mid-Market, APAC/EMEA Mid-Market, and Startup/SMB programs. You’ll also own **GRC Hub** and **Secure Circle**, our CISO peer group, and bring field programs into our broader ABM motion.

* **Build programs that move buyers forward.** Run conferences, executive dinners, roundtables, and partner-led experiences. Align with Sales and SDRs on target accounts, meeting goals, outreach, follow-up, and nurture, and embed account-specific field plays into our ABM motion.
* **Grow communities and executive relationships.** Own GRC Hub and Secure Circle, creating programming that builds membership, engagement, and pipeline. Bring the right buyers into the room and turn members into speakers, hosts, and advocates.
* **Lead the team and build repeatable systems.** Coach three regional field marketers, own hiring and headcount planning, and build reusable playbooks for execution and reporting. Manage vendors and agencies, and partner with Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Finance to keep programs consistent and well-run.
* **Experiment and turn learning into action.** Test new markets, formats, gifting, and activations with clear hypotheses and budget caps. Use AI to improve research, targeting, content, and reporting, and turn successful experiments into programs the team can repeat.

### **The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* **You’ve built and led field marketing teams.** You bring 8–12 years in B2B marketing, including 5+ in SaaS field or regional marketing and 3+ managing field marketers, ideally across regions.
* **You can connect programs to commercial outcomes.** You’ve owned multi-region budgets and pipeline targets, can demonstrate program ROI, and are comfortable building your own analysis in HubSpot.
* **You understand different markets and buyers.** You’ve run programs in at least two of the US, UK/Europe, Middle East, or India/APAC, reaching startup/SMB buyers and mid-market or enterprise security, IT, or GRC leaders.

We also built Voncierge, our own AI and video customer-service platform. Visitors get help through QR codes, web, app or kiosks, answered by an AI avatar or a live agent over video. Voncierge is live at Changi Airport and Jewel Changi, and we’re in conversations with airports across Asia and North America.

**The role**This is our first senior marketing hire. You’ll own marketing across both businesses, with 60:40 split on Voncierge and Hipster. There’s no playbook waiting for you: you’ll set the strategy, decide where the budget goes, and run it. You’ll report to the CEO and lead a small growth team (a growth manager and an intern).

This is a player-coach role. You’ll set the positioning and also write and ship the campaigns yourself.

**What you’ll own**

* Positioning and messaging for both brands, and how they strengthen each other
* Pipeline: qualified meetings for our business development team, against a target you help set
* Account-based campaigns into airports, government agencies and large enterprises
* Case studies, content and thought leadership that build trust in long sales cycles
* Events and trade shows, from pre-event outreach to post-event follow-up
* Marketing support for proposals and tenders, working with our India-based proposals team
* Our marketing tools (LinkedIn, Apollo, website, CRM) and reporting on what’s working
* Budget, agencies and freelancers

**In your first 90 days**

* Write the marketing plan for both brands and agree targets with the CEO
* Launch your first account-based campaign into a priority sector
* Set up monthly reporting on marketing-sourced pipeline

**You’re a fit if you have**

* 5+ years in B2B marketing, including building marketing from scratch at a company under ~100 people
* A track record of owning a pipeline or revenue number, and you can tell us what it was
* Experience with long, complex sales cycles: enterprise, government or tenders
* Strong writing: you can produce a sharp case study or LinkedIn post yourself
* Comfort using AI tools to get more done with a small team
* The discipline to work independently and remotely, with clear written communication

**Nice to have**

* Background in conversational AI, customer-experience tech, SaaS or IT services
* Exposure to airports, travel or facilities management
* Experience marketing across APAC and North America

**This probably isn’t for you if** you’re used to large budgets and big teams, and you prefer directing agencies to doing the work yourself.

* Real ownership: your plan, your budget, your calls
* A direct line to the CEO and a voice in company strategy
* Remote work within APAC time zones (GMT+5:30 to GMT+8)
* A product already live at one of the world’s leading airports, so you’re marketing something real
* Room to build and lead a bigger team as we grow

k’LAH’ng Digest is an upcoming newsletter based in Malaysia covering the latest news, happenings, events, businesses and community stories around Klang Valley. Our goal is to help people stay connected to what is happening around them through a newsletter that is informative, engaging and enjoyable to read.

We’re a startup at the early stages of building our brand, audience and sponsorship opportunities. We’re looking for a creative, self-motivated person who wants to be part of the journey from the beginning and help turn the project into a sustainable media brand.

**The Role**

We’re looking for someone who can wear multiple hats: **newsletter writer, social media content creator and digital marketer**.

You’ll be responsible for turning local stories and research into engaging newsletters, repurposing newsletter content for social media, creating advertisements, and helping attract sponsors and grow our audience.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys writing, has an eye for design, understands social media and knows how to create content that gets people's attention.

jobs.title: Associate Director / Director, Nonclinical Toxicology
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Associate Director or Director of Toxicology
to join our nonclinical development team to support discovery and development programs, with a primary focus on nonclinical study oversight and toxicology. The primary focus of this role is to act as a key scientific and operational interface with external contract research organizations (CROs). The individual in this role will assume primary responsibility for the planning, execution, and monitoring of nonclinical studies, ensuring scientific rigor, data quality, and alignment with program timelines and regulatory expectations. This position requires strong scientific judgment, knowledge of regulatory guidance, effective communication, and the ability to independently manage multiple studies in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment. This role will also contribute to the preparation of nonclinical components of regulatory dossiers related documentation.

This individual will also serve as a scientific and strategic partner to cross-functional project teams, driving the design, execution, and interpretation of nonclinical toxicology studies in support of IND-enabling and lifecycle safety assessment programs. The role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders (project leaders, DMPK, regulatory affairs, clinical development) as well as direct oversight of external Contract Research Organizations (CROs) conducting GLP and non-GLP toxicology studies.

This is a hands-on, operationally-focused role: the ideal candidate pairs strong scientific judgment with the rigor to keep multiple CRO-run studies on schedule, on budget, and audit-ready.

The level of hire (Associate Director vs. Director) will be determined based on the candidate's experience, scope of responsibility, and demonstrated leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Author, review, and finalize toxicology study protocols, amendments, and study reports in collaboration with CRO partners, ensuring scientific rigor and regulatory compliance.
Interface directly with CROs to scope, place, monitor, and troubleshoot in-life toxicology studies (GMP and non-GMP), including dose range-finding, repeat-dose, safety pharmacology, and specialized studies as needed.
Serve as Study Monitor for in-life toxicology studies, including on-site or virtual monitoring visits, real-time issue resolution, and direct follow-up with CRO study directors to keep studies on track.
Own budget tracking and oversight for assigned studies — reviewing CRO quotes and change orders, monitoring spend against forecast, and flagging deviations to project teams and finance.
Review and interpret toxicology data (clinical pathology, histopathology, TK/PK) to assess safety signals and inform risk assessment and dose selection.
Author and contribute toxicology sections for IND (or CTA) submissions, Investigator's Brochures, and briefing documents; support preparation of responses to health authority questions.
Partner with DMPK, pharmacology, CMC, and clinical teams to integrate toxicology findings into overall program risk/benefit assessments.
Track study timelines, budgets, and deliverables across multiple concurrent CRO-run studies; escalate risks and resolve issues proactively.
Stay current with regulatory guidance (FDA, ICH, EMA) and industry best practices in toxicology and nonclinical safety assessment.
Serve as toxicology representative and strategic partner on multidisciplinary project teams, providing scientific input on nonclinical safety strategy from discovery through IND/CTA filing and beyond.

Required Qualifications

S., M.S., Ph.D., DVM, or advanced degree in Toxicology, Pharmacology, Veterinary Medicine, or a related biomedical science (or equivalent experience).
5–10 years of relevant experience in toxicology within pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO settings.
Demonstrated experience writing and reviewing toxicology study plans/protocols and final study reports.
Direct experience managing or interfacing with CROs conducting in-life toxicology studies.
Experience serving as Study Monitor on GMP toxicology studies, including in-life visits, protocol/report review, and direct communication with CRO study directors.
Working knowledge of study budgets — able to review CRO quotes/change orders, track spend against budget, and flag scope or cost deviations to project teams.
Solid understanding of GMP regulations, ICH guidelines (e.g., M3(R2), S9, S6), and FDA/EMA nonclinical safety expectations.
Demonstrated experience contributing toxicology content to IND submissions (or CTA equivalent), including authoring nonclinical written summaries and supporting health authority interactions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey complex scientific concepts to cross-functional and non-toxicology audiences.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects and timelines in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
DABT (Diplomate, American Board of Toxicology) certification strongly recommended.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience across multiple modalities (small molecule, biologics, ADCs) preferred but not required.
Prior experience in a sponsor-side role managing external vendor relationships.
Experience presenting toxicology data to internal governance committees or health authorities.
Experience with Veeva or other document management systems.
